# Langsys API Documentation
Version: 1.0.0

Translation management API

## Authentication

### bearerAuth
Type: http
Scheme: bearer
Description: Enter token in format (Bearer <token>)

### apiKey
Type: apiKey
Name: X-Authorization
In: header
Description: An ApiKey security string

## Endpoints

### API Key

#### GET /api-keys
Summary: List API Keys
Operation ID: `a8a7a0ea6a191301f2dd26d26d31e424`

Description: Get all API keys the authenticated user has access to. Optionally filter by organization_id or project_id. organization_id will be ignored if project_id is provided as well. User must be an admin to access the api keys of a project or organization. Results can be ordered by: name, description, type, active, last_used_at, created_at, updated_at, id.

Security Requirements:
- bearerAuth

Parameters:
- `organization_id` in query: Filter results by organization ID
  Type: string
  Example: `"10a14bd4-4e17-4524-ab06-5b3ac55f7cf9"`
- `project_id` in query: Filter results by project ID
  Type: string
  Example: `"10a14bd4-4e17-4524-ab06-5b3ac55f7cf9"`
- `order_by` in query: Order results by specified field(s). Supports single field (order_by=field:direction) or multiple fields for tie-breaking (order_by[]=field1:direction&order_by[]=field2:direction).

**Orderable fields:** `type`, `description`, `last_used_at`, `active`, `name`

**Default order:** `name:asc`
  Type: Composition (one of)
  Example: `"name:asc"`
- `filter_by` in query: Filter results by field values. Supports single filter (filter_by=field:value) or multiple filters (filter_by[]=field1:value&filter_by[]=field2:value).

**Filterable fields:** `active`, `name`, `type`

**Default filters:** `active:true`
  Type: Composition (one of)
  Example: `"active:true"`

Responses:
- 200: success
  Content-Type: `application/json`
  Schema:
    Type: array
    Items: 
      # Schema: ApiKeyListResponse
      Type: object
      Properties:
        status:
          Type: boolean
          Description: Response status
          Example: true

        data:
          Type: array
          Items: 
            allOf:
              # Schema: ApiKey
              Type: object
              Properties:
                id:
                  Type: string
                  Example: "d72dfd6c-c149-41f4-8533-7965c821ff73"

                name:
                  Type: string
                  Example: "Langsys Production Api Key"

                description:
                  Type: string
                  Description: Description of the API key
                  Example: "This API key is used for production environment"

                type:
                  Type: string
                  Enum: ["read", "write"]
                  Example: "write"

                active:
                  Type: boolean
                  Example: true

                created_at:
                  Type: integer
                  Description: Unix timestamp of when the api key was created.
                  Example: 1781149482

                updated_at:
                  Type: integer
                  Description: Unix timestamp of when the api key was last updated.
                  Example: 1781149482

                last_used_at:
                  Type: integer
                  Description: Unix timestamp of when the api key was last used.
                  Example: 1781149482

                project:
                  allOf:
                    # Schema: ProjectBasic
                    Type: object
                    Properties:
                      id:
                        Type: string
                        Example: "b701387c-b400-4163-b4f8-5241b9cf4e4b"

                      title:
                        Type: string
                        Example: "Comercado"


                  Description: Details of the associated project.

                organization:
                  allOf:
                    # Schema: OrganizationBasic
                    Type: object
                    Properties:
                      id:
                        Type: string
                        Example: "de136a2b-9ab4-4fa0-8e77-1c876dbc090c"

                      name:
                        Type: string
                        Description: The name of the organization
                        Example: "Prof. Milo Little"

                      email:
                        Type: string
                        Description: The email of the organization
                        Example: "rosemary74@gmail.com"


                  Description: Details of the associated organization.



          Description: List of items



  Example Response:
```json
[
  {
    "status": true,
    "data": [
      {
        "id": "d72dfd6c-c149-41f4-8533-7965c821ff73",
        "name": "Langsys Production Api Key",
        "description": "This API key is used for production environment",
        "type": "write",
        "active": true,
        "created_at": 1781149482,
        "updated_at": 1781149482,
        "last_used_at": 1781149482,
        "project": {
          "id": "b701387c-b400-4163-b4f8-5241b9cf4e4b",
          "title": "Comercado"
        },
        "organization": {
          "id": "de136a2b-9ab4-4fa0-8e77-1c876dbc090c",
          "name": "Prof. Milo Little",
          "email": "rosemary74@gmail.com"
        }
      }
    ]
  }
]
```
- 401: Unauthorized
  Content-Type: `application/json`
  Schema:
    # Schema: UNAUTHORIZED_ERROR
    Type: object
    Properties:
      error:
        Type: string
        Default: "Unauthorized"
        Description: Error description

      code:
        Type: integer

#### POST /api/api-keys
Summary: Create a new API Key
Operation ID: `b013bbb35fa7ea324771a93c12145b80`

Description: Create a new API key and associate it with a project.

Security Requirements:
- bearerAuth

Request Body:
Content-Type: `application/json`
Schema:
  # Schema: ApiKeyCreateRequest
  Type: object
  Properties:
    project_id (Required):
      Type: string
      Description: The project ID to associate the API key with.
      Example: "89bb60d7-af6e-4e5c-b769-5dc45782bb9f"

    name (Required):
      Type: string
      Description: The name of the API key.
      Example: "My API Key"

    description:
      Type: string
      Example: "This API key is used for production environment"

    type (Required):
      Type: string
      Enum: ["read", "write"]
      Default: "read"
      Description: The type of the API key.
      Example: "write"

    active (Required):
      Type: boolean
      Default: true
      Description: Whether the API key is active.
      Example: true



Responses:
- 200: Success
  Content-Type: `application/json`
  Schema:
    # Schema: ApiKeyCreatedResponse
    Type: object
    Properties:
      status:
        Type: boolean
        Description: Response status
        Example: true

      data:
        # Inferred schema: ApiKeyCreated
        # Schema: ApiKeyCreated
        Type: object
        Properties:
          id:
            Type: string
            Example: "1e9ae4fa-f557-4243-9674-125b92ad32e0"

          name:
            Type: string
            Example: "Langsys Production Api Key"

          description:
            Type: string
            Description: Description of the API key
            Example: "This API key is used for production environment"

          type:
            Type: string
            Enum: ["read", "write"]
            Example: "write"

          active:
            Type: boolean
            Example: true

          key:
            Type: string
            Description: The actual API key value
            Example: "l8hqXC29KVUJamjxTV2nRSwEh0PyYiucf3UCOUZ6elL54AcrHsbI4YAXFA59Gdf2"

          created_at:
            Type: integer
            Description: Unix timestamp of when the api key was created.
            Example: 1781149482

          updated_at:
            Type: integer
            Description: Unix timestamp of when the api key was last updated.
            Example: 1781149482

          last_used_at:
            Type: integer
            Description: Unix timestamp of when the api key was last used.
            Example: 1781149482

          project:
            allOf:
              # Schema: ProjectBasic
              Type: object
              Properties:
                id:
                  Type: string
                  Example: "b701387c-b400-4163-b4f8-5241b9cf4e4b"

                title:
                  Type: string
                  Example: "Comercado"


            Description: Details of the associated project.

          organization:
            allOf:
              # Schema: OrganizationBasic
              Type: object
              Properties:
                id:
                  Type: string
                  Example: "de136a2b-9ab4-4fa0-8e77-1c876dbc090c"

                name:
                  Type: string
                  Description: The name of the organization
                  Example: "Prof. Milo Little"

                email:
                  Type: string
                  Description: The email of the organization
                  Example: "rosemary74@gmail.com"


            Description: Details of the associated organization.



  Example Response:
```json
{
  "status": true,
  "data": {
    "id": "1e9ae4fa-f557-4243-9674-125b92ad32e0",
    "name": "Langsys Production Api Key",
    "description": "This API key is used for production environment",
    "type": "write",
```

### API Key - Reports

#### GET /api/api-keys/{apiKeyId}/activity
Summary: Get activity history per day for an API key
Operation ID: `ce6b303261e24e34a0291d9eeebe6d3d`

Description: Get per day activity for an specific API key

Security Requirements:
- bearerAuth
- apiKey

Parameters:
- `apiKeyId` in path (Required): Id of API Key
  Type: string
  Example: `"03b8eacb-197c-4b83-ab5a-4ba88820ada1"`
- `start_date` in query: Start date for the activity range
  Type: string
  Example: `"2024-01-01"`
- `end_date` in query: End date for the activity range
  Type: string
  Example: `"2024-01-31"`

Responses:
- 200: Success
  Content-Type: `application/json`
  Schema:
    # Schema: ActivityPaginatedResponse
    Type: object
    Properties:
      status:
        Type: boolean
        Description: Response status
        Example: true

      page:
        Type: integer
        Description: Current page number
        Example: 1

      records_per_page:
        Type: integer
        Description: Number of records per page
        Example: 8

      page_count:
        Type: integer
        Description: Number of pages
        Example: 5

      total_records:
        Type: integer
        Description: Total number of items
        Example: 40

      data:
        Type: array
        Items: 
          allOf:
            # Schema: Activity
            Type: object
            Properties:
              date:
                Type: integer
                Description: Log date.
                Example: 130

              get_requests:
                Type: integer
                Description: Total number of get requests.
                Example: 130

              post_requests:
                Type: integer
                Description: Total number of post requests.
                Example: 130

              patch_requests:
                Type: integer
                Description: Total number of patch requests.
                Example: 130

              delete_requests:
                Type: integer
                Description: Total number of delete requests.
                Example: 130



        Description: List of items


  Example Response:
```json
{
  "status": true,
  "page": 1,
  "records_per_page": 8,
  "page_count": 5,
  "total_records": 40,
  "data": [
    {
      "date": 130,
      "get_requests": 130,
      "post_requests": 130,
      "patch_requests": 130,
      "delete_requests": 130
    }
  ]
}
```
- 401: Unauthorized
  Content-Type: `application/json`
  Schema:
    # Schema: UNAUTHORIZED_ERROR
    Type: object
    Properties:
      error:
        Type: string
        Default: "Unauthorized"
        Description: Error description

      code:
        Type: integer
        Default: 401
        Description: Error Code

```json

  "code": 1
}
```

#### GET /api/api-keys/{apiKeyId}/usage
Summary: Get API usage units per day for an API key
Operation ID: `2848ff7785b219f912ac8c328058032f`

Description: Get per day API usage units for a specific API key

Security Requirements:
- bearerAuth
- apiKey

Parameters:
- `apiKeyId` in path (Required): Id of API Key
  Type: string
  Example: `"03b8eacb-197c-4b83-ab5a-4ba88820ada1"`
- `start_date` in query: Start date for the activity range
  Type: string
  Example: `"2024-01-01"`
- `end_date` in query: End date for the activity range
  Type: string
  Example: `"2024-01-31"`

Responses:
- 200: Success
  Content-Type: `application/json`
  Schema:
    # Schema: ApiKeyUsageResponse
    Type: object
    Properties:
      status:
        Type: boolean
        Description: Response status
        Example: true

      data:
        # Inferred schema: ApiKeyUsage
        # Schema: ApiKeyUsage
        Type: object
        Properties:
          date:
            Type: integer
            Description: The date of the usage data
            Example: 2025

          api_usage_units:
            Type: integer
            Description: The number of API usage units consumed
            Example: 150



  Example Response:
```json
{
  "status": true,
  "data": {
    "date": 2025,
    "api_usage_units": 150
  }
}
```
- 401: Unauthorized
  Content-Type: `application/json`
  Schema:
    # Schema: UNAUTHORIZED_ERROR
    Type: object
    Properties:
      error:
        Type: string
        Default: "Unauthorized"
        Description: Error description

      code:
        Type: integer
        Default: 401
        Description: Error Code


  Example Response:
```json
{
  "error": "string",
  "code": 1
}
```
- 422: Validation Error
  Content-Type: `application/json`
  Schema:
    # Schema: UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY_ERROR
    Type: object
    Properties:
      error:
        Type: string
        Default: "Unprocessable Entity"
        Description: Error description

      code:
        Type: integer
        Default: 422
        Description: Error Code


  Example Response:
```json
{
  "error": "string",
  "code": 1
}
```

#### POST /api/register
Summary: Register New User
Operation ID: `a718f172ff3ac464d723835815f8fb57`

Description: Register a new user. An organization may be created as part of the registration process. Otherwise, it will need to be created later in order.

Request Body:
Content-Type: `application/json`
Schema:
  # Schema: RegisterRequest
  Type: object
  Properties:
    firstname (Required):
      Type: string
      Example: "Ashtyn"

    lastname (Required):
      Type: string
      Example: "Cronin"

    email (Required):
      Type: string
      Example: "constantin05@dooley.net"

    password (Required):
      Type: string
      Example: "K4x5mnscP&555"

    password_confirmation (Required):
      Type: string
      Example: "K4x5mnscP&555"

    subscription_billing_address (Required):
      allOf:
        # Schema: BillingAddressData
        Type: object
        Properties:
          name:
            Type: string
            Description: Name for this billing address
            Example: "Home"

          address_1:
            Type: string
            Description: Primary billing address line
            Example: "Guachipelín de Escazú"

          address_2:
            Type: string
            Description: Secondary billing address line
            Example: "Ofibodegas #5"

          city:
            Type: string
            Description: City
            Example: "Escazú"

          state:
            Type: string
            Description: State/Province
            Example: "San José"

          zip:
            Type: string
            Description: ZIP/Postal code
            Example: "10203"

          country_code:
            Type: string
            Description: Country code
            Example: "US"



    plan_type (Required):
      Type: string
      Enum: ["free", "business"]
      Default: "free"
      Example: "free"

    plan_cycle (Required):
      Type: string
      Enum: ["monthly", "quarterly", "biannual", "yearly", "lifetime"]
      Default: "lifetime"
      Example: "lifetime"

    credit_card:
      allOf:
        # Schema: CreditCardData
        Type: object
        Properties:
          cc_number:
            Type: string
            Description: Full credit card number.
            Example: "4111111111111111"

          cc_month:
            Type: string
            Description: Card expiration month (2 digits).
            Example: "02"

          cc_year:
            Type: string
            Description: Card expiration year (4 digits).
            Example: "2025"

          cc_name:
            Type: string
            Description: Cardholder name as it appears on the card.
            Example: "John Doe"

          cc_cvv:
            Type: string
            Description: Card Verification Value - the 3-digit security code on the back of most cards (4 digits on front for American Express).
            Example: "123"



    organization:
      allOf:
        # Schema: OrganizationData
        Type: object
        Properties:
          name:
            Type: string
            Example: "My Organization"

          email:
            Type: string
            Example: "jasmin90@donnelly.biz"

          website_url:
            Type: string
            Example: "https://www.example.com"

          icon:
            allOf:
              # Schema: Photo
              Type: object
              Properties:
                id:
                  Type: string
                  Example: "7c5c39d2-2c46-407d-b60b-72a7b2de63b1"

                path:
                  Type: string
                  Description: Local path of the photo.
                  Example: "/public/images"

                provider:
                  Type: string
                  Enum: ["gravatar", "imagekit", "custom"]
                  Example: "custom"

                width:
                  Type: integer
                  Description: Width of the photo in pixels.
                  Example: 582

                height:
                  Type: integer
                  Description: Height of the photo in pixels.
                  Example: 265

                original:
                  Type: string
                  Description: Url of the original size of the photo
                  Example: "https://example.com/original.jpg"

                medium:
                  Type: string
                  Description: Url of the medium size of the photo
                  Example: "https://example.com/medium.jpg"

                thumb:
                  Type: string
                  Description: Url of the thumbnail size of the photo
                  Example: "https://example.com/thumb.jpg"



          logo:
            allOf:
              # Schema: Photo
              Type: object
              Properties:
                id:
                  Type: string
                  Example: "7c5c39d2-2c46-407d-b60b-72a7b2de63b1"

                path:
                  Type: string
                  Description: Local path of the photo.
                  Example: "/public/images"

                provider:
                  Type: string
                  Enum: ["gravatar", "imagekit", "custom"]
                  Example: "custom"

                width:
                  Type: integer
                  Description: Width of the photo in pixels.
                  Example: 582

                height:
                  Type: integer
                  Description: Height of the photo in pixels.
                  Example: 265

                original:
                  Type: string
                  Description: Url of the original size of the photo
                  Example: "https://example.com/original.jpg"

                medium:
                  Type: string
                  Description: Url of the medium size of the photo
                  Example: "https://example.com/medium.jpg"

                thumb:
                  Type: string
                  Description: Url of the thumbnail size of the photo
                  Example: "https://example.com/thumb.jpg"



          settings:
            allOf:
              # Schema: OrganizationSettingsData
              Type: object
              Properties:
                locales:
                  allOf:
                    # Schema: LocaleSettingsData
                    Type: object
                    Properties:
                      base_locale:
                        Type: string
                        Default: "en-us"
                        Description: Project wide setting that determines the base locale for the project.
                        Example: "en-us"

                      target_locales:
                        Type: array
                        Items: 
                          Type: string
                          Example: "es-cr"

                        Description: Project wide setting that determines the target locales for the project.

                      default_locales:
                        Type: object
                          (No properties defined - generic object)
                        Description: Project wide setting that determines the default locales for each language in the project.
                        Example: {"es":"es-cr"}

                      use_translation_memory:
                        Type: boolean
                        Default: true
                        Description: Project wide setting that determines whether the system should look in Translation Memory when using the translation search algorithm.
                        Example: true

                      locale_code_format:
                        Type: string
                        Enum: ["lowercase-hyphen", "bcp47", "posix"]
                        Default: "lowercase-hyphen"
                        Description: Organization wide setting that determines the format of locale codes in API responses.
                        Example: "lowercase-hyphen"



                ai_translator:
                  allOf:
                    # Schema: AiTranslatorSettingsData
                    Type: object
                    Properties:
                      machine_translate_new_phrases:
                        Type: boolean
                        Default: true
                        Description: Project wide setting that determines whether the system should generate a machine translation for each new phrase created; this will only happen if the phrase doesnt have a translation/machine translation in the Organizations Translation Memory or if it has machine translations in the Organizations Translation Memory but the use_translation_memory setting is disabled.
                        Example: true

                      use_machine_translations:
                        Type: boolean
                        Default: true
                        Description: Project wide setting that determines whether the system should return machine translations when searching for translations through the translations endpoint.
                        Example: true

                      translate_base_locale_only:
                        Type: boolean
                        Default: false
                        Description: Project wide setting that when enabled will detect the language of your phrases before machine translating.  If it matches base_locale, it will be allowed to machine translate. If another locale is detected, the phrase will be marked to never translate automatically. Language detection may have an additional cost per phrase.  Use this option if you have mixed language content and want to be sure that other languages stay in their original form.
                        Example: true

                      tier:
                        Type: string
                        Enum: ["basic", "smart", "premium"]
                        Default: "smart"
                        Description: Translation tier — basic (Google, fastest/cheapest), smart (budget LLM, default), or premium (top-quality LLM). The underlying model is selected by langsys-ai based on the chosen tier.
                        Example: "smart"



                billing:
                  allOf:
                    # Schema: OrganizationBillingSettingsData
                    Type: object
                    Properties:
                      monthly_credit_usage_limit:
                        Type: number
                        Format: float
                        Default: 0
                        Description: Organization wide setting that determines the monthly usage limit for the organization.
                        Example: 20

                      auto_recharge_enabled:
                        Type: boolean
                        Default: false
                        Description: Organization wide setting that determines whether the system should automatically recharge the organization when the usage limit is reached.
                        Example: true

                      auto_recharge_threshold:
                        Type: number
                        Format: float
                        Default: 0
                        Description: Organization wide setting that determines the threshold for automatic recharge.
                        Example: 20

                      auto_recharge_amount:
                        Type: number
                        Format: float
                        Default: 0
                        Description: Organization wide setting that determines the amount to recharge.
                        Example: 20

                      auto_recharge_source:
                        Type: string
                        Enum: ["account_balance", "credit_card", "account_balance_or_credit_card", "credit_card_or_account_balance"]
                        Default: "account_balance_or_credit_card"
                        Description: Organization wide setting that determines the source of the automatic recharge.
                        Example: "credit_card"

                      allow_draw_projects:
                        Type: boolean
                        Default: true
                        Description: Organization wide setting that determines whether the system should allow projects to draw funds from the organization.
                        Example: true

                      draw_projects_limit_monthly:
                        Type: number
                        Format: float
                        Description: Organization wide setting that determines the monthly limit for drawing funds from the projects.
                        Example: 20





          address:
            allOf:
              # Schema: Address
              Type: object
              Properties:
                address_1:
                  Type: string
                  Example: "Guachipelín de Escazú"

                address_2:
                  Type: string
                  Example: "Ofibodegas #5"

                city:
                  Type: string
                  Example: "Escazú"

                state:
                  Type: string
                  Example: "San José"

                zip:
                  Type: string
                  Example: "10203"

                country_code:
                  Type: string
                  Example: "CR"

                country:
                  Type: string
                  Example: "Costa Rica"







Responses:
- 200: Success
  Content-Type: `application/json`
  Schema:
    # Schema: UserExtendedResponse
    Type: object
    Properties:
      status:
        Type: boolean
        Description: Response status
        Example: true

      data:
        # Inferred schema: UserExtended
        # Schema: UserExtended
        Type: object
        Properties:
          id:
            Type: string
            Example: "a439d7c9-9502-4b58-94d8-e8cd284f99b6"

          firstname:
            Type: string
            Example: "Jon"

          lastname:
            Type: string
            Example: "Nader"

          email:
            Type: string
            Example: "princess.terry@hotmail.com"

          phone:
            Type: string
            Example: "+1 (336) 902-8883"

          locale:
            Type: string
            Example: "es-cr"

          last_seen_at:
            Type: integer
            Description: Unix timestamp indicating last time the user interacted with the system.
            Example: 1781149482

          created_at:
            Type: integer
            Description: Unix timestamp indicating creation date.
            Example: 1781149482

          avatar:
            allOf:
              # Schema: Avatar
              Type: object
              Properties:
                width:
                  Type: integer
                  Example: 451

                height:
                  Type: integer
                  Example: 209

                original_url:
                  Type: string
                  Example: "http://www.reinger.com/quod-distinctio-enim-et-veniam-aliquid-id-labore"

                thumb_url:
                  Type: string
                  Example: "http://schaden.info/saepe-aliquid-facilis-id-in-et-qui"

                medium_url:
                  Type: string
                  Example: "http://www.schoen.org/"

                id:
                  Type: string
                  Example: "73daa05e-d24b-4b46-82c7-6fdd97f17b64"

                path:
                  Type: string
                  Description: Path of local file
                  Example: "/public/images"


            Description: Avatar object with meta data and urls for the different sizes. Defaults to gravatar urls if not found.

          source_locales:
            Type: array
            Items: 
              Type: string
              Example: "pt_PT"

            Description: List of locales user can translate from

          target_locales:
            Type: array
            Items: 
              Type: string
              Example: "sh_YU"

            Description: List of locales user can translate to

          settings:
            allOf:
              # Schema: UserSettingsData
              Type: object
              Properties:
                notifications:
                  allOf:
                    # Schema: UserNotificationSettingsData
                    Type: object
                    Properties:
                      new_translatable_items:
                        Type: array
                        Items: 
                          Type: string
                          Example: "broadcast"

                        Description: List of channels for new translatable items notifications. Every time a batch of phrases is created in any of the projects where the user holds a translator role, the user will receive a notification through the selected channels. Leave empty to not receive any notifications.

                      invitation:
                        Type: array
                        Items: 
                          Type: string
                          Example: "broadcast"

                        Description: List of channels for invitation notifications. Every time a user is invited to a project or organization, the user will receive a notification through the selected channels. Leave empty to not receive any notifications.

                      added_to_entity:
                        Type: array
                        Items: 
                          Type: string
                          Example: "broadcast"

                        Description: List of channels for added to entity notifications. Every time a user is directly added to a project or organization (without going through the invitation flow), the user will receive a notification through the selected channels. Leave empty to not receive any notifications.


                  Description: The user notification settings

                billing:
                  allOf:
                    # Schema: UserBillingSettingsData
                    Type: object
                    Properties:
                      monthly_credit_usage_limit:
                        Type: number
                        Format: float
                        Default: 0
                        Description: The maximum amount that can be drawn from the monthly balance of the user.
                        Example: 100

                      auto_recharge_enabled:
                        Type: boolean
                        Default: false
                        Description: Whether auto recharge is enabled for the user
                        Example: true

                      auto_recharge_threshold:
                        Type: number
                        Format: float
                        Default: 10
                        Description: The amount that the balance of the user must drop below to trigger auto recharge.
                        Example: 20

                      auto_recharge_amount:
                        Type: number
                        Format: float
                        Default: 50
                        Description: The amount that will be added to the balance of the user when auto recharge is triggered.
                        Example: 20

                      allow_draw_organizations:
                        Type: boolean
                        Default: true
                        Description: Whether the organizations can draw from the balance of the user
                        Example: true

                      draw_organizations_limit_monthly:
                        Type: number
                        Format: float
                        Default: 20
                        Description: The monthly limit that a single organization can draw from the balance of the user
                        Example: 100


                  Description: The user billing settings

#### GET /api/countries/{userLocale}
Summary: Get List of Countries in Specified Language
Operation ID: `268f63d611dbdbb6ac3191765ebdcdc2`

Description: Get a complete list of all countries with the country name in {localeCode} as label attribute. Pagination parameters are optional. Results can be ordered by: label, code, created_at, updated_at, id.

Security Requirements:
- bearerAuth
- apiKey

Parameters:
- `userLocale` in path (Required): URL paramater representing locale code to display the data in.
  Type: string
  Example: `"en-us"`
- `page` in query: Page to request
  Type: integer
  Example: `"1"`
- `records_per_page` in query: Number of records per page
  Type: integer
  Example: `"10"`
- `filter_by` in query: Filter results by field values. Supports single filter (filter_by=field:value) or multiple filters (filter_by[]=field1:value&filter_by[]=field2:value).

**Default filters:** none
  Type: Composition (one of)
  Example: `"field:value"`

Responses:
- 200: Success
  Content-Type: `application/json`
  Schema:
    # Schema: CountryPaginatedResponse
    Type: object
    Properties:
      status:
        Type: boolean
        Description: Response status
        Example: true

      page:
        Type: integer
        Description: Current page number
        Example: 1

      records_per_page:
        Type: integer
        Description: Number of records per page
        Example: 8

      page_count:
        Type: integer
        Description: Number of pages
        Example: 5

      total_records:
        Type: integer
        Description: Total number of items
        Example: 40

      data:
        Type: array

Summary: Get a list of locales grouped by language
Operation ID: `95012f210cfbfb6894ebeb36c8fa637c`

#### GET /api/plans
Summary: List subscription plans
Operation ID: `000824ea04c2b5f2039de937145a6035`

Description: Retrieve all pricing rows (one per plan + billing cycle) whose parent plan is publicly live.

Security Requirements:
- bearerAuth

Responses:
- 200: Success
  Content-Type: `application/json`
  Schema:
    # Schema: PlanPaginatedResponse
    Type: object
    Properties:
      status:
        Type: boolean
        Description: Response status
        Example: true

      page:
        Type: integer
        Description: Current page number
        Example: 1

      records_per_page:
        Type: integer
        Description: Number of records per page
        Example: 8

      page_count:
        Type: integer
        Description: Number of pages
        Example: 5

      total_records:
        Type: integer
        Description: Total number of items
        Example: 40

      data:
        Type: array
        Items: 
          allOf:
            # Schema: Plan
            Type: object
            Properties:
              id:
                Type: string
                Description: Plan cycle ID (one pricing row per plan + cycle combination).
                Example: "a3b8c9d0-1234-5678-9abc-def012345678"

              plan_id:
                Type: string
                Description: Parent plan ID.
                Example: "c9fa6b09-9077-4253-b224-50b28ed9a987"

              name:
                Type: string
                Description: Display name of the plan.
                Example: "Business Plan"

              type:
                Type: string
                Enum: ["free", "business"]
                Description: Type of the plan.
                Example: "business"

              cycle:
                Type: string
                Enum: ["monthly", "quarterly", "biannual", "yearly", "lifetime"]
                Description: Billing cycle for this pricing row.
                Example: "monthly"

              price:
                Type: number
                Format: float
                Description: Price for this cycle. Null when the cycle is free.
                Example: 29

              currency:
                Type: string
                Description: ISO 4217 currency code for the price.
                Example: "USD"

              free_credits:
                Type: number
                Format: float
                Description: Free credits granted to a new subscription on this cycle.
                Example: 100

              max_projects:
                Type: integer
                Description: Maximum number of projects allowed for this plan.
                Example: 10

              max_locales:
                Type: integer
                Description: Maximum number of locales allowed for this plan.
                Example: 5

              max_users:
                Type: integer
                Description: Maximum number of users allowed for this plan.
                Example: 25

              max_translator_users:
                Type: integer
                Description: Maximum number of translator users allowed for this plan.
                Example: 10



        Description: List of items


  Example Response:
```json
{
  "status": true,
  "page": 1,
  "records_per_page": 8,
  "page_count": 5,
  "total_records": 40,
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "a3b8c9d0-1234-5678-9abc-def012345678",
      "plan_id": "c9fa6b09-9077-4253-b224-50b28ed9a987",
      "name": "Business Plan",
      "type": "business",
      "cycle": "monthly",
      "price": 29,
      "currency": "USD",
      "free_credits": 100,
      "max_projects": 10,
      "max_locales": 5,
      "max_users": 25,
      "max_translator_users": 10
    }
  ]
}
```

### Billing - Invoices

#### GET /api/billing/invoices
Summary: Get all invoices for the authenticated user
Operation ID: `801e82fa884af97991e38ffcc985359b`

Description: Fetch all invoices for the currently authenticated user.

Security Requirements:
- bearerAuth

Parameters:
- `order_by` in query: Order results by specified field(s). Supports single field (order_by=field:direction) or multiple fields for tie-breaking (order_by[]=field1:direction&order_by[]=field2:direction).

**Orderable fields:** `type`, `file_name`, `status`, `created_at`

**Default order:** `created_at:desc`
  Type: Composition (one of)
  Example: `"created_at:desc"`
- `filter_by` in query: Filter results by field values. Supports single filter (filter_by=field:value) or multiple filters (filter_by[]=field1:value&filter_by[]=field2:value).

**Filterable fields:** `status`, `type`

**Default filters:** none
  Type: Composition (one of)
  Example: `"status:value"`

Responses:
- 200: Success
  Content-Type: `application/json`
  Schema:
    # Schema: InvoiceResponse
    Type: object
    Properties:
      status:
        Type: boolean
        Description: Response status
        Example: true

      data:
        # Inferred schema: Invoice
        # Schema: Invoice
        Type: object
        Properties:
          id:
            Type: string
            Description: Invoice ID.
            Example: "ecc232d9-e5e2-4eed-b8c7-095e00dec1a9"

          user_id:
            Type: string
            Description: User ID who owns the invoice.
            Example: "39cd3625-7302-4bf2-bf9f-2eeeee81514a"

          invoice_number:
            Type: string
            Description: Invoice number.
            Example: "20251201_203157"

          client_invoice_number:
            Type: string
            Description: Client invoice number.
            Example: "LANGSYS_INV_20251201_203157"

          type:
            Type: string
            Enum: ["subscription", "prepaid_credits", "refund", "void", "enterprise"]
            Description: Invoice type.
            Example: "subscription"

          status:
            Type: string
            Description: Invoice status.
            Example: "paid"

          amount:
            Type: string
            Description: Invoice amount.
            Example: "100.00"

          currency:
            Type: string
            Description: Currency.
            Example: "USD"

          description:
            Type: string
            Description: Description of the invoice.
            Example: "Monthly subscription payment"

          billing_name:
            Type: string
            Description: Billing name.
            Example: "F Good Company"

          billing_address_1:
            Type: string
            Description: Billing address line 1.
            Example: "Guachipelín de Escazú"

          billing_address_2:
            Type: string
            Description: Billing address line 2.
            Example: "Ofibodegas #6"

          billing_city:
            Type: string
            Description: Billing city.
            Example: "Escazú"

          billing_state:
            Type: string
            Description: Billing state.
            Example: "San José"

          billing_zip:
            Type: string
            Description: Billing zip code.
            Example: "10203"

          billing_country_code:
            Type: string
            Description: Billing country code.
            Example: "CR"

          pdf_invoice_url:
            Type: string
            Description: PDF invoice URL.
            Example: "https://ik.imagekit.io/dk8tdco09/langsys/invoice.pdf"

          file_name:
            Type: string

Description: Machine translate a list of translatable items using the project's tier setting or an override. For content blocks, all associated phrases will be translated. Optionally specify target locales; if not provided, all default target locales for the project will be used.

- bearerAuth

### Notification

#### GET /api/notifications
Summary: Get User's Notifications
Operation ID: `0bb334cc4f9efd4fc1e6a0b32d8cd65d`

Description: Get all notifications the authenticated user has. Pagination parameters are optional. Results can be ordered by: message, action, read_at, created_at, updated_at, id.

Security Requirements:
- bearerAuth

Parameters:
- `page` in query: Page to request
  Type: integer
  Example: `"1"`
- `records_per_page` in query: Number of records per page
  Type: integer
  Example: `"10"`
- `filter_by` in query: Filter results by field values. Supports single filter (filter_by=field:value) or multiple filters (filter_by[]=field1:value&filter_by[]=field2:value).

**Filterable fields:** `action`, `read_at`

**Default filters:** none
  Type: Composition (one of)
  Example: `"action:value"`

Responses:
- 200: success
  Content-Type: `application/json`
  Schema:
    # Schema: NotificationPaginatedResponseWithMeta
    Type: object
    Properties:
      status:
        Type: boolean
        Description: Response status
        Example: true

      page:
        Type: integer
        Description: Current page number
        Example: 1

      page_count:
        Type: integer
        Description: Total number of pages
        Example: 5

      records_per_page:
        Type: integer
        Description: Number of records per page
        Example: 8

      total_records:
        Type: integer
        Description: Total number of records
        Example: 40

      read:
        Type: integer
        Description: Number of read notifications
        Example: 4

      unread:
        Type: integer
        Description: Number of unread notifications
        Example: 3

      data:
        Type: array
        Items: 
          # Schema: Notification
          Type: object
          Properties:
            id:
              Type: string
              Example: "08e8b894-e967-40ba-a9a7-13a5af1bcf61"

            message:
              Type: string
              Example: "8 new phrase(s) have been created in Project ABC"

            type:
              Type: string
              Enum: ["invitation", "new_translatable_items", "added_to_entity"]
              Description: Type of notification. Should be used by client to decide how to display the notification.
              Example: "new_translatable_items"

            data:
              allOf:
                # Schema: NotificationPayloadData
                Type: object
                Properties:
                  entity_ids:
                    Type: array
                    Items: 
                      Type: string
                      Example: "9f5ef8c1-edc7-4aab-8f69-2e0ac37f75b8"



              Description: Data of notification. Will be flexible based on the notification type, but will at least contain a list of entity IDs the notification is related to.

            created_at:
              Type: integer
              Example: 1781149482

            read_at:
              Type: integer
              Example: 1781149482


        Description: Array of notifications


  Example Response:
```json
{
  "status": true,
  "page": 1,
  "page_count": 5,
  "records_per_page": 8,
  "total_records": 40,
  "read": 4,
  "unread": 3,
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "08e8b894-e967-40ba-a9a7-13a5af1bcf61",
      "message": "8 new phrase(s) have been created in Project ABC",
      "type": "new_translatable_items",
      "data": {
        "entity_ids": [
          "9f5ef8c1-edc7-4aab-8f69-2e0ac37f75b8"
        ]
      },
      "created_at": 1781149482,
      "read_at": 1781149482
    }
  ]
}
```

#### GET /api/organizations/{organizationId}/credits/transactions
Summary: Get Organization Credit Transactions
Operation ID: `39f18c51c0875e90e158138c9961b3b5`

Description: Get the credit balance of an organization.

Security Requirements:
- bearerAuth

Parameters:
- `organizationId` in path (Required): Id of organization
  Type: string
  Example: `"10a14bd4-4e17-4524-ab06-5b3ac55f7cf9"`
- `page` in query: Page to request
  Type: integer
  Example: `"1"`
- `records_per_page` in query: Number of records per page
  Type: integer
  Example: `"10"`
- `start_date` in query: Start date for the activity range
  Type: string
  Example: `"2024-01-01"`
- `end_date` in query: End date for the activity range
  Type: string
  Example: `"2024-01-31"`
- `order_by` in query: Order results by specified field(s). Supports single field (order_by=field:direction) or multiple fields for tie-breaking (order_by[]=field1:direction&order_by[]=field2:direction).

**Orderable fields:** `created_at`, `amount`, `type`, `tier`

**Default order:** `created_at:desc`
  Type: Composition (one of)
  Example: `"created_at:desc"`
- `filter_by` in query: Filter results by field values. Supports single filter (filter_by=field:value) or multiple filters (filter_by[]=field1:value&filter_by[]=field2:value).

**Filterable fields:** `tier`, `type`

**Default filters:** none
  Type: Composition (one of)
  Example: `"tier:value"`

Responses:
- 200: Success
  Content-Type: `application/json`
  Schema:
    # Schema: BalanceTransactionPaginatedResponse
    Type: object
    Properties:
      status:
        Type: boolean
        Description: Response status
        Example: true

      page:
        Type: integer
        Description: Current page number
        Example: 1

      records_per_page:
        Type: integer
        Description: Number of records per page
        Example: 8

      page_count:
        Type: integer
        Description: Number of pages
        Example: 5

      total_records:
        Type: integer
        Description: Total number of items
        Example: 40

      data:
        Type: array
        Items: 
          allOf:
            # Schema: BalanceTransaction
            Type: object
            Properties:
              id:
                Type: string
                Description: Transaction ID
                Example: "123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174001"

              entity_id:
                Type: string
                Description: Entity ID
                Example: "123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000"

              entity_type:
                Type: string
                Description: Entity type (user, organization, project)
                Example: "user"

              amount:
                Type: string
                Description: Transaction amount
                Example: 50

              type:
                Type: string
                Enum: ["credit", "auto_recharge", "machine_translation", "draw_from_account", "draw_from_organization", "prepaid_credits_invoiced", "free_credits_granted", "machine_translation_refund", "machine_translation_topup", "prepaid_credits_transfer", "free_credits_transfer", "api_usage", "coupon_redemption"]
                Description: Transaction type
                Example: "credit"

              balance_before:
                Type: string
                Description: Balance before transaction
                Example: 50

              balance_after:
                Type: string
                Description: Balance after transaction
                Example: 50

              prepaid_credit:
                Type: boolean
                Description: Pre-paid credit
                Example: true

              reference_entity_id:
                Type: string
                Description: Reference Entity ID
                Example: "ref_123"

              reference_entity_type:
                Type: string
                Description: Reference Entity Type
                Example: "user"

              tier:
                Type: string
                Enum: ["basic", "smart", "premium"]
                Description: Translation tier (machine-translation rows only).
                Example: "smart"

              machine_translation_transaction_id:
                Type: string
                Description: Machine Translation Transaction ID
                Example: "123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174002"

              created_at:
                Type: integer
                Description: Transaction date
                Example: 1781149482



        Description: List of items


  Example Response:

#### GET /api/organizations

Description: Get a paginated list of all organizations. Pagination parameters are optional.

- bearerAuth

Parameters:
- `page` in query: Page to request
  Type: integer
  Example: `"1"`
- `records_per_page` in query: Number of records per page
  Type: integer
  Example: `"10"`
- `order_by` in query: Order results by specified field(s). Supports single field (order_by=field:direction) or multiple fields for tie-breaking (order_by[]=field1:direction&order_by[]=field2:direction).

**Orderable fields:** `last_activity_at`, `email`, `admin`, `name`, `user_joined_at`

**Default order:** `name:asc`
  Type: Composition (one of)
  Example: `"name:asc"`
- `filter_by` in query: Filter results by field values. Supports single filter (filter_by=field:value) or multiple filters (filter_by[]=field1:value&filter_by[]=field2:value).

**Filterable fields:** `admin`, `email`, `name`

**Default filters:** none
  Type: Composition (one of)

#### PATCH /api/organizations/{organzationId}
Summary: Update Organization
Operation ID: `ee25615e229768458a3fe6bc81c051af`

Description: Update an organization.

Security Requirements:
- bearerAuth

Parameters:
- `organizationId` in path (Required): Id of organization
  Type: string
  Example: `"10a14bd4-4e17-4524-ab06-5b3ac55f7cf9"`

Request Body:
Content-Type: `application/json`
Schema:
  # Schema: OrganizationUpdateRequest
  Type: object
  Properties:
    name:
      Type: string
      Example: "Langosh-Grant"

    email:
      Type: string
      Example: "madison.rath@quitzon.com"

    website_url:
      Type: string
      Example: "https://www.example.com"

    icon:
      allOf:
        # Schema: Photo
        Type: object
        Properties:
          id:
            Type: string
            Example: "7c5c39d2-2c46-407d-b60b-72a7b2de63b1"

          path:
            Type: string
            Description: Local path of the photo.
            Example: "/public/images"

          provider:
            Type: string
            Enum: ["gravatar", "imagekit", "custom"]
            Example: "custom"

          width:
            Type: integer
            Description: Width of the photo in pixels.
            Example: 582

          height:
            Type: integer
            Description: Height of the photo in pixels.
            Example: 265

          original:
            Type: string
            Description: Url of the original size of the photo
            Example: "https://example.com/original.jpg"

          medium:
            Type: string
            Description: Url of the medium size of the photo
            Example: "https://example.com/medium.jpg"

          thumb:
            Type: string
            Description: Url of the thumbnail size of the photo
            Example: "https://example.com/thumb.jpg"



    logo:
      allOf:
        # Schema: Photo
        Type: object

            Example: "7c5c39d2-2c46-407d-b60b-72a7b2de63b1"

            Type: integer
            Description: Height of the photo in pixels.
            Example: 265

          original:
            Type: string
            Description: Url of the original size of the photo
            Example: "https://example.com/original.jpg"

          medium:
            Type: string
            Description: Url of the medium size of the photo
            Example: "https://example.com/medium.jpg"

          thumb:
            Type: string
            Description: Url of the thumbnail size of the photo
            Example: "https://example.com/thumb.jpg"



    address:
      allOf:
        # Schema: Address
        Type: object
        Properties:
          address_1:
            Type: string
            Example: "Guachipelín de Escazú"

          address_2:
            Type: string
            Example: "Ofibodegas #5"

          city:
            Type: string
            Example: "Escazú"

          state:
            Type: string
            Example: "San José"

          zip:
            Type: string
            Example: "10203"

          country_code:
            Type: string
            Example: "CR"

          country:
            Type: string
            Example: "Costa Rica"



    settings:
      allOf:
        # Schema: OrganizationSettingsData
        Type: object
        Properties:
          locales:
            allOf:
              # Schema: LocaleSettingsData
              Type: object
              Properties:
                base_locale:
                  Type: string
                  Default: "en-us"
                  Description: Project wide setting that determines the base locale for the project.
                  Example: "en-us"

                target_locales:
                  Type: array
                  Items: 
                    Type: string
                    Example: "es-cr"

                  Description: Project wide setting that determines the target locales for the project.

                default_locales:
                  Type: object
                    (No properties defined - generic object)
                  Description: Project wide setting that determines the default locales for each language in the project.
                  Example: {"es":"es-cr"}

                use_translation_memory:
                  Type: boolean
                  Default: true
                  Description: Project wide setting that determines whether the system should look in Translation Memory when using the translation search algorithm.
                  Example: true

                locale_code_format:
                  Type: string
                  Enum: ["lowercase-hyphen", "bcp47", "posix"]
                  Default: "lowercase-hyphen"
                  Description: Organization wide setting that determines the format of locale codes in API responses.
                  Example: "lowercase-hyphen"



          ai_translator:
            allOf:
              # Schema: AiTranslatorSettingsData
              Type: object
              Properties:
                machine_translate_new_phrases:
                  Type: boolean
                  Default: true
                  Description: Project wide setting that determines whether the system should generate a machine translation for each new phrase created; this will only happen if the phrase doesnt have a translation/machine translation in the Organizations Translation Memory or if it has machine translations in the Organizations Translation Memory but the use_translation_memory setting is disabled.
                  Example: true

                use_machine_translations:
                  Type: boolean
                  Default: true
                  Description: Project wide setting that determines whether the system should return machine translations when searching for translations through the translations endpoint.
                  Example: true

                translate_base_locale_only:
                  Type: boolean
                  Default: false
                  Description: Project wide setting that when enabled will detect the language of your phrases before machine translating.  If it matches base_locale, it will be allowed to machine translate. If another locale is detected, the phrase will be marked to never translate automatically. Language detection may have an additional cost per phrase.  Use this option if you have mixed language content and want to be sure that other languages stay in their original form.
                  Example: true

                tier:
                  Type: string
                  Enum: ["basic", "smart", "premium"]
                  Default: "smart"
                  Description: Translation tier — basic (Google, fastest/cheapest), smart (budget LLM, default), or premium (top-quality LLM). The underlying model is selected by langsys-ai based on the chosen tier.
                  Example: "smart"



          billing:
            allOf:
              # Schema: OrganizationBillingSettingsData
              Type: object
              Properties:

                  Type: number
                  Format: float
                  Default: 0
                  Description: Organization wide setting that determines the monthly usage limit for the organization.
                  Example: 20

                auto_recharge_enabled:
                  Type: boolean
                  Default: false
                  Description: Organization wide setting that determines whether the system should automatically recharge the organization when the usage limit is reached.
                  Example: true

                auto_recharge_threshold:
                  Type: number
                  Format: float
                  Default: 0
                  Description: Organization wide setting that determines the threshold for automatic recharge.
                  Example: 20

                auto_recharge_amount:
                  Type: number
                  Format: float
                  Default: 0
                  Description: Organization wide setting that determines the amount to recharge.
                  Example: 20

                auto_recharge_source:
                  Type: string
                  Enum: ["account_balance", "credit_card", "account_balance_or_credit_card", "credit_card_or_account_balance"]
                  Default: "account_balance_or_credit_card"
                  Description: Organization wide setting that determines the source of the automatic recharge.
                  Example: "credit_card"

                allow_draw_projects:
                  Type: boolean
                  Default: true
                  Description: Organization wide setting that determines whether the system should allow projects to draw funds from the organization.
                  Example: true

                draw_projects_limit_monthly:
                  Type: number
                  Format: float
                  Description: Organization wide setting that determines the monthly limit for drawing funds from the projects.
                  Example: 20

- bearerAuth

      Example: "800d4bae-a4c0-44ab-ac82-fdc4406801cb"

    role:
      Type: string
      Enum: ["organization_admin", "organization_user", "billing_manager"]
      Default: "organization_user"
      Description: Role of the user in the organization
      Example: "organization_admin"

    email:
      Type: string
      Description: Provide an email if user is new. Email can also be provided for existing users if userId is not provided in the URI.
      Example: "marques55@hoppe.com"

    disabled_projects:
      Type: array
      Items: 
        Type: string
        Example: "3f8f583a-1fcf-44ba-894e-23d9693d55ec"

      Description: A list of the ids of projects that will be disabled for the user. This list will sync with the currently disabled projects of the user.

- 200: Success

  Schema:
    # Schema: InvitationResponse

    Properties:
      status:
        Type: boolean

        # Inferred schema: Invitation
        # Schema: Invitation
        Type: object
        Properties:
          id:
            Type: string
            Example: "61cb3f55-1e48-4444-972f-b3b77d13a756"

          inviter_id:
            Type: string
            Example: "f6195075-3285-4ada-9534-f8ad76bc7e66"

          inviter:
            Type: string
            Example: "John Doe"

          invitee_id:
            Type: string
            Example: "19ed4aa1-2238-4162-820e-1d282952eb90"

          invitee:
            Type: string
            Example: "John Miles"

          email:
            Type: string
            Example: "renner.laurence@pouros.com"

          entity_id:

                              Type: string
                              Example: "es-cr"

                            Description: Project wide setting that determines the target locales for the project.

                          default_locales:
                            Type: object
                              (No properties defined - generic object)
                            Description: Project wide setting that determines the default locales for each language in the project.
                            Example: {"es":"es-cr"}

                          use_translation_memory:
                            Type: boolean
                            Default: true
                            Description: Project wide setting that determines whether the system should look in Translation Memory when using the translation search algorithm.
                            Example: true

                          locale_code_format:
                            Type: string
                            Enum: ["lowercase-hyphen", "bcp47", "posix"]
                            Default: "lowercase-hyphen"
                            Description: Organization wide setting that determines the format of locale codes in API responses.
                            Example: "lowercase-hyphen"



                    ai_translator:
                      allOf:
                        # Schema: AiTranslatorSettingsData
                        Type: object
                        Properties:
                          machine_translate_new_phrases:
                            Type: boolean
                            Default: true
                            Description: Project wide setting that determines whether the system should generate a machine translation for each new phrase created; this will only happen if the phrase doesnt have a translation/machine translation in the Organizations Translation Memory or if it has machine translations in the Organizations Translation Memory but the use_translation_memory setting is disabled.
                            Example: true

                          use_machine_translations:
                            Type: boolean
                            Default: true
                            Description: Project wide setting that determines whether the system should return machine translations when searching for translations through the translations endpoint.
                            Example: true

                          translate_base_locale_only:
                            Type: boolean
                            Default: false
                            Description: Project wide setting that when enabled will detect the language of your phrases before machine translating.  If it matches base_locale, it will be allowed to machine translate. If another locale is detected, the phrase will be marked to never translate automatically. Language detection may have an additional cost per phrase.  Use this option if you have mixed language content and want to be sure that other languages stay in their original form.
                            Example: true

                          tier:
                            Type: string
                            Enum: ["basic", "smart", "premium"]
                            Default: "smart"
                            Description: Translation tier — basic (Google, fastest/cheapest), smart (budget LLM, default), or premium (top-quality LLM). The underlying model is selected by langsys-ai based on the chosen tier.
                            Example: "smart"



                    billing:
                      allOf:
                        # Schema: ProjectBillingSettingsData
                        Type: object
                        Properties:
                          monthly_credit_usage_limit:
                            Type: number
                            Format: float
                            Default: 0
                            Description: Project wide setting that determines the monthly usage limit for the project. Setting to 0 is equivalent to unlimited usage.
                            Example: 20

                          auto_recharge_enabled:
                            Type: boolean
                            Default: false
                            Description: Project wide setting that determines whether the system should automatically recharge the project when the usage limit is reached.
                            Example: true

                          auto_recharge_threshold:
                            Type: number
                            Format: float
                            Default: 0
                            Description: Project wide setting that determines the threshold for automatic recharge.
                            Example: 20

                          auto_recharge_amount:
                            Type: number
                            Format: float
                            Default: 0
                            Description: Project wide setting that determines the amount to recharge.
                            Example: 20

                          auto_recharge_source:
                            Type: string
                            Enum: ["organization_balance", "credit_card", "organization_balance_or_credit_card", "credit_card_or_organization_balance"]
                            Default: "organization_balance_or_credit_card"
                            Description: Project wide setting that determines the source of the automatic recharge.
                            Example: "credit_card"





              admin:
                Type: boolean
                Example: true

              last_activity_at:
                Type: integer
                Example: 1781149482

              totals:
                allOf:
                  # Schema: GeneralProjectTotals
                  Type: object
                  Properties:
                    phrases:
                      Type: integer
                      Description: Total number of phrases in project.
                      Example: 291

                    words:
                      Type: integer
                      Description: Total number of words in project.
                      Example: 755

                    words_across_locales:
                      Type: integer
                      Description: Total translation workload in words across all target locales (words * target_locales). Not the remaining amount; see untranslated.words for words still to translate.
                      Example: 3020

                    target_locales:
                      Type: integer
                      Description: Total number of target locales the user can access. Translators can only see target locales assigned to them.
                      Example: 4



              role:
                allOf:
                  # Schema: RoleData
                  Type: object
                  Properties:
                    value:
                      Type: string
                      Description: Role value
                      Example: "organization_admin"

                    label:
                      Type: string
                      Description: Role label
                      Example: "Organization Admin"

                Description: Timestamp when the user joined the project or when they got access to it
                Example: 1781149482

                Type: integer
                Example: 1781149482

              updated_at:
                Type: integer
                Example: 1781149482

              deleted_at:
                Type: integer
                Example: 1781149482



        Description: List of items

### Organization - Settings

#### PATCH /api/organizations/{organizationId}/settings
Summary: Set Organization Settings
Operation ID: `50d09ab80187519e6daf85595a65c9a1`

Description: Set the settings for an organization.

Security Requirements:
- bearerAuth

Parameters:
- `organizationId` in path (Required): Id of organization
  Type: string
  Example: `"10a14bd4-4e17-4524-ab06-5b3ac55f7cf9"`

Request Body:
Content-Type: `application/json`
Schema:
  # Schema: ProjectSettingsRequest
  Type: object
  Properties:
    locales:
      allOf:
        # Schema: LocaleSettingsData
        Type: object
        Properties:
          base_locale:
            Type: string
            Default: "en-us"
            Description: Project wide setting that determines the base locale for the project.
            Example: "en-us"

          target_locales:
            Type: array
            Items: 
              Type: string
              Example: "es-cr"

            Description: Project wide setting that determines the target locales for the project.

          default_locales:
            Type: object
              (No properties defined - generic object)
            Description: Project wide setting that determines the default locales for each language in the project.
            Example: {"es":"es-cr"}

          use_translation_memory:
            Type: boolean
            Default: true
            Description: Project wide setting that determines whether the system should look in Translation Memory when using the translation search algorithm.
            Example: true

          locale_code_format:
            Type: string
            Enum: ["lowercase-hyphen", "bcp47", "posix"]
            Default: "lowercase-hyphen"
            Description: Organization wide setting that determines the format of locale codes in API responses.
            Example: "lowercase-hyphen"



    ai_translator:
      allOf:
        # Schema: AiTranslatorSettingsData
        Type: object
        Properties:
          machine_translate_new_phrases:
            Type: boolean
            Default: true
            Description: Project wide setting that determines whether the system should generate a machine translation for each new phrase created; this will only happen if the phrase doesnt have a translation/machine translation in the Organizations Translation Memory or if it has machine translations in the Organizations Translation Memory but the use_translation_memory setting is disabled.
            Example: true

          use_machine_translations:
            Type: boolean
            Default: true
            Description: Project wide setting that determines whether the system should return machine translations when searching for translations through the translations endpoint.
            Example: true

          translate_base_locale_only:

#### GET /api/organizations/{organizationId}/users
Summary: List Organization Users
Operation ID: `37a57e93defda8f967670ec3f9d20f52`

Description: Get a list of users who have access to this organization. Pagination parameters are optional.

Security Requirements:
- bearerAuth

Parameters:
- `organizationId` in path (Required): Id of organization
  Type: string
  Example: `"10a14bd4-4e17-4524-ab06-5b3ac55f7cf9"`
- `page` in query: Page to request
  Type: integer
  Example: `"1"`
- `records_per_page` in query: Number of records per page
  Type: integer
  Example: `"10"`
- `order_by` in query: Order results by specified field(s). Supports single field (order_by=field:direction) or multiple fields for tie-breaking (order_by[]=field1:direction&order_by[]=field2:direction).

**Orderable fields:** `created_at`, `role`

**Default order:** `created_at:desc`
  Type: Composition (one of)
  Example: `"created_at:desc"`
- `filter_by` in query: Filter results by field values. Supports single filter (filter_by=field:value) or multiple filters (filter_by[]=field1:value&filter_by[]=field2:value).

**Default filters:** none
  Type: Composition (one of)
  Example: `"field:value"`

Responses:
- 200: Success
  Content-Type: `application/json`
  Schema:
    # Schema: UserOrganizationAccessPaginatedResponse
    Type: object
    Properties:
      status:
        Type: boolean
        Description: Response status
        Example: true

      page:
        Type: integer
        Description: Current page number
        Example: 1

      records_per_page:
        Type: integer
        Description: Number of records per page
        Example: 8

      page_count:
        Type: integer
        Description: Number of pages
        Example: 5

      total_records:
        Type: integer
        Description: Total number of items
        Example: 40

      data:
        Type: array
        Items: 
          allOf:
            # Schema: UserOrganizationAccess
            Type: object
            Properties:
              id:
                Type: string
                Example: "bc6bf674-98ec-4ff2-b252-101a62566f0b"

              firstname:
                Type: string
                Example: "Elvie"

              lastname:
                Type: string
                Example: "Ratke"

              avatar:
                allOf:
                  # Schema: Avatar
                  Type: object
                  Properties:
                    width:
                      Type: integer
                      Example: 451

                    height:
                      Type: integer
                      Example: 209

                    original_url:
                      Type: string
                      Example: "http://www.reinger.com/quod-distinctio-enim-et-veniam-aliquid-id-labore"

                    thumb_url:
                      Type: string
                      Example: "http://schaden.info/saepe-aliquid-facilis-id-in-et-qui"

                    medium_url:
                      Type: string
                      Example: "http://www.schoen.org/"

                    id:
                      Type: string
                      Example: "73daa05e-d24b-4b46-82c7-6fdd97f17b64"

                    path:
                      Type: string
                      Description: Path of local file
                      Example: "/public/images"



              last_activity_at:
                Type: integer
                Example: 1660229953

              role:
                allOf:
                  # Schema: RoleData
                  Type: object
                  Properties:
                    value:
                      Type: string
                      Description: Role value
                      Example: "organization_admin"

                    label:
                      Type: string
                      Description: Role label
                      Example: "Organization Admin"



              invited_by:
                allOf:
                  # Schema: UserData
