#### GET /api/organizations/{organizationId}/users/settings
Summary: Get User Organization Settings
Operation ID: `17c6fa71abf5a629cb6130738626bbc6`

Description: Get overridden user settings for an organization. Will return an empty object if no settings are overridden for the user in the organization.

Security Requirements:
- bearerAuth

Parameters:
- `organizationId` in path (Required): Id of organization
  Type: string
  Example: `"10a14bd4-4e17-4524-ab06-5b3ac55f7cf9"`

Responses:
- 200: Success
  Content-Type: `application/json`
  Schema:
    # Schema: UserSettingsResponse
    Type: object
    Properties:
      status:
        Type: boolean
        Description: Response status
        Example: true

      data:
        # Inferred schema: UserSettings
        # Schema: UserSettings
        Type: object
        Properties:
          notifications:
            allOf:
              # Schema: UserNotificationSettingsData
              Type: object
              Properties:
                new_translatable_items:
                  Type: array
                  Items: 
                    Type: string
                    Example: "broadcast"

                  Description: List of channels for new translatable items notifications. Every time a batch of phrases is created in any of the projects where the user holds a translator role, the user will receive a notification through the selected channels. Leave empty to not receive any notifications.

                invitation:
                  Type: array
                  Items: 
                    Type: string
                    Example: "broadcast"

                  Description: List of channels for invitation notifications. Every time a user is invited to a project or organization, the user will receive a notification through the selected channels. Leave empty to not receive any notifications.

                added_to_entity:
                  Type: array
                  Items: 
                    Type: string
                    Example: "broadcast"

                  Description: List of channels for added to entity notifications. Every time a user is directly added to a project or organization (without going through the invitation flow), the user will receive a notification through the selected channels. Leave empty to not receive any notifications.


            Description: The user notification settings

          billing:
            allOf:
              # Schema: UserBillingSettingsData
              Type: object
              Properties:
                monthly_credit_usage_limit:
                  Type: number
                  Format: float
                  Default: 0
                  Description: The maximum amount that can be drawn from the monthly balance of the user.
                  Example: 100

                auto_recharge_enabled:
                  Type: boolean
                  Default: false
                  Description: Whether auto recharge is enabled for the user
                  Example: true

                auto_recharge_threshold:
                  Type: number
                  Format: float
                  Default: 10
                  Description: The amount that the balance of the user must drop below to trigger auto recharge.
                  Example: 20

                auto_recharge_amount:
                  Type: number
                  Format: float
                  Default: 50
                  Description: The amount that will be added to the balance of the user when auto recharge is triggered.
                  Example: 20

                allow_draw_organizations:
                  Type: boolean
                  Default: true
                  Description: Whether the organizations can draw from the balance of the user
                  Example: true

                draw_organizations_limit_monthly:
                  Type: number
                  Format: float
                  Default: 20
                  Description: The monthly limit that a single organization can draw from the balance of the user
                  Example: 100


            Description: The user billing settings



  Example Response:
```json
{
  "status": true,
  "data": {
    "notifications": {
      "new_translatable_items": [
        "broadcast"
      ],
      "invitation": [
        "broadcast"
      ],
      "added_to_entity": [
        "broadcast"
      ]
    },
    "billing": {
      "monthly_credit_usage_limit": 100,
      "auto_recharge_enabled": true,
      "auto_recharge_threshold": 20,
      "auto_recharge_amount": 20,
      "allow_draw_organizations": true,
      "draw_organizations_limit_monthly": 100
    }
  }
}
```

                thumb_url:
                  Type: string
                  Example: "http://schaden.info/saepe-aliquid-facilis-id-in-et-qui"

                  Description: Path of local file
                  Example: "/public/images"


            Description: Avatar object with meta data and urls for the different sizes. Defaults to gravatar urls if not found.

          source_locales:
            Type: array
            Items: 
              Type: string
              Example: "pt_PT"

            Description: List of locales user can translate from

          target_locales:
            Type: array
            Items: 
              Type: string
              Example: "sh_YU"

            Description: List of locales user can translate to

          settings:
            allOf:
              # Schema: UserSettingsData
              Type: object
              Properties:
                notifications:
                  allOf:
                    # Schema: UserNotificationSettingsData
                    Type: object
                    Properties:
                      new_translatable_items:
                        Type: array
                        Items: 
                          Type: string
                          Example: "broadcast"

                        Description: List of channels for new translatable items notifications. Every time a batch of phrases is created in any of the projects where the user holds a translator role, the user will receive a notification through the selected channels. Leave empty to not receive any notifications.

                      invitation:
                        Type: array
                        Items: 
                          Type: string
                          Example: "broadcast"

                        Description: List of channels for invitation notifications. Every time a user is invited to a project or organization, the user will receive a notification through the selected channels. Leave empty to not receive any notifications.

                      added_to_entity:
                        Type: array
                        Items: 
                          Type: string
                          Example: "broadcast"

                        Description: List of channels for added to entity notifications. Every time a user is directly added to a project or organization (without going through the invitation flow), the user will receive a notification through the selected channels. Leave empty to not receive any notifications.


                  Description: The user notification settings

                billing:
                  allOf:
                    # Schema: UserBillingSettingsData
                    Type: object
                    Properties:
                      monthly_credit_usage_limit:
                        Type: number
                        Format: float
                        Default: 0
                        Description: The maximum amount that can be drawn from the monthly balance of the user.
                        Example: 100

                      auto_recharge_enabled:
                        Type: boolean
                        Default: false
                        Description: Whether auto recharge is enabled for the user
                        Example: true

                      auto_recharge_threshold:
                        Type: number
                        Format: float
                        Default: 10
                        Description: The amount that the balance of the user must drop below to trigger auto recharge.
                        Example: 20

                      auto_recharge_amount:
                        Type: number
                        Format: float
                        Default: 50
                        Description: The amount that will be added to the balance of the user when auto recharge is triggered.
                        Example: 20

                      allow_draw_organizations:
                        Type: boolean
                        Default: true
                        Description: Whether the organizations can draw from the balance of the user
                        Example: true

                      draw_organizations_limit_monthly:
                        Type: number
                        Format: float
                        Default: 20
                        Description: The monthly limit that a single organization can draw from the balance of the user
                        Example: 100


                  Description: The user billing settings

### Billing - Payment Methods

#### GET /api/billing/payment-methods
Summary: Get credit cards belonging to user
Operation ID: `1d7deb6e9887e8a0639b9452c470a246`

Description: Fetch all available credit cards for the authenticated user. Can be filtered by organization or project.

Security Requirements:
- bearerAuth

Parameters:
- `page` in query: Page to request
  Type: integer
  Example: `"1"`
- `records_per_page` in query: Number of records per page
  Type: integer
  Example: `"10"`
- `order_by` in query: Order results by specified field(s). Supports single field (order_by=field:direction) or multiple fields for tie-breaking (order_by[]=field1:direction&order_by[]=field2:direction).

**Orderable fields:** `cc_name`, `cc_year`, `cc_brand`, `default`, `cc_month`

**Default order:** `default:desc`, `cc_brand:asc`
  Type: Composition (one of)
  Example: `"default:desc"`
- `filter_by` in query: Filter results by field values. Supports single filter (filter_by=field:value) or multiple filters (filter_by[]=field1:value&filter_by[]=field2:value).

**Default filters:** none
  Type: Composition (one of)
  Example: `"field:value"`

Responses:
- 200: Success
  Content-Type: `application/json`
  Schema:
    # Schema: PaymentMethodPaginatedResponse
    Type: object
    Properties:
      status:
        Type: boolean
        Description: Response status
        Example: true

      page:
        Type: integer
        Description: Current page number
        Example: 1

      records_per_page:
        Type: integer
        Description: Number of records per page
        Example: 8

      page_count:
        Type: integer
        Description: Number of pages
        Example: 5

      total_records:
        Type: integer
        Description: Total number of items
        Example: 40

      data:
        Type: array
        Items: 
          allOf:
            # Schema: PaymentMethod
            Type: object
            Properties:
              id:
                Type: string
                Description: Credit card id.
                Example: "19b3b92a-3399-4a3f-a121-afbd89a75d22"

              cc_mask:
                Type: string
                Description: Masked credit card number.
                Example: "4111-1111-1111-1111"

              cc_brand:
                Type: string
                Description: Type of card.
                Example: "VISA"

              cc_name:
                Type: string
                Description: Name on the credit card.
                Example: "Joe Doe"

              alias:
                Type: string
                Description: Alias/nickname for the payment method.
                Example: "My Work Card"

              cc_month:
                Type: string
                Description: Expiration month.
                Example: "01"

              cc_year:
                Type: string
                Description: Expiration year.
                Example: "2025"

              address_1:
                Type: string
                Description: Primary billing address line
                Example: "Guachipelín de Escazú"

              address_2:
                Type: string
                Description: Secondary billing address line
                Example: "Ofibodegas #5"

              city:
                Type: string
                Description: City
                Example: "Escazú"

              state:
                Type: string
                Description: State/Province
                Example: "San José"

              zip:
                Type: string
                Description: ZIP/Postal code
                Example: "10203"

              country_code:
                Type: string
                Description: Country code
                Example: "CR"

              owner_id:
                Type: string
                Example: "d6b47319-313e-466e-8f00-abe14b7810ba"

              is_default_for_context:
                Type: boolean
                Description: Is default payment method for the current context (organization/project).
                Example: "true"



        Description: List of items


  Example Response:
```json
{
  "status": true,
  "page": 1,
  "records_per_page": 8,
  "page_count": 5,

  ]
}
```

#### POST /api/billing/payment-methods
Summary: Add a new credit card
Operation ID: `64d5eaffc688e6e5d7e4b80eff838f87`

Description: Add a new credit card for the authenticated user.

Security Requirements:
- bearerAuth

Request Body:
Required: Yes
Content-Type: `application/json`
Schema:
  # Schema: CreditCardRequest
  Type: object

      Example: "4111111111111111"

    cc_name (Required):
      Type: string
      Description: Cardholder name as it appears on the card.
      Example: "John Doe"

    cc_month (Required):
      Type: string
      Description: Card expiration month (2 digits).
      Example: "02"

    cc_year (Required):
      Type: string
      Description: Card expiration year (4 digits).
      Example: "2025"

    alias:
      Type: string
      Description: Alias/nickname for this payment method.
      Example: "My Work Card"

    auto_generate_alias:
      Type: boolean
      Description: Auto-generate alias if not provided.
      Example: false

    cc_cvv:
      Type: string
      Description: Card Verification Value - the 3-digit security code on the back of most cards (4 digits on front for American Express).
      Example: "123"

    country_code:
      Type: string
      Description: Two-letter ISO country code where the card was issued or the billing address is located.
      Example: "US"

            Description: ZIP/Postal code
            Example: "10203"

          country_code:
            Type: string
            Description: Country code
            Example: "US"

    is_default:

      Default: false
      Description: Set this card as the default payment method.
      Example: true

    user_billing_address_id:
      Type: string
      Description: ID of user billing address to use for this credit card
      Example: "c6157dcf-c275-49a3-a96f-e81e8db2b0cb"

### Plans

#### GET /api/plans/{plan_type}/{plan_cycle}
Summary: Get plan details
Operation ID: `1ee363bff9814dd182248ec72a79919e`

Description: Get the pricing row for a given plan type and billing cycle.

Security Requirements:
- bearerAuth

Parameters:
- `plan_type` in path (Required): No description
  Type: string
  Example: `"business"`
- `plan_cycle` in path (Required): No description
  Type: string
  Example: `"monthly"`

Responses:
- 200: Success
  Content-Type: `application/json`
  Schema:
    # Schema: PlanResponse
    Type: object
    Properties:
      status:
        Type: boolean
        Description: Response status
        Example: true

      data:
        # Inferred schema: Plan
        # Schema: Plan
        Type: object
        Properties:
          id:
            Type: string
            Description: Plan cycle ID (one pricing row per plan + cycle combination).
            Example: "a3b8c9d0-1234-5678-9abc-def012345678"

          plan_id:
            Type: string
            Description: Parent plan ID.
            Example: "c9fa6b09-9077-4253-b224-50b28ed9a987"

          name:
            Type: string
            Description: Display name of the plan.
            Example: "Business Plan"

          type:
            Type: string
            Enum: ["free", "business"]
            Description: Type of the plan.
            Example: "business"

          cycle:
            Type: string
            Enum: ["monthly", "quarterly", "biannual", "yearly", "lifetime"]
            Description: Billing cycle for this pricing row.
            Example: "monthly"

          price:
            Type: number
            Format: float
            Description: Price for this cycle. Null when the cycle is free.
            Example: 29

          currency:
            Type: string
            Description: ISO 4217 currency code for the price.
            Example: "USD"

          free_credits:
            Type: number
            Format: float
            Description: Free credits granted to a new subscription on this cycle.
            Example: 100

          max_projects:
            Type: integer
            Description: Maximum number of projects allowed for this plan.
            Example: 10

          max_locales:
            Type: integer
            Description: Maximum number of locales allowed for this plan.
            Example: 5

          max_users:
            Type: integer
            Description: Maximum number of users allowed for this plan.
            Example: 25

          max_translator_users:
            Type: integer
            Description: Maximum number of translator users allowed for this plan.
            Example: 10



  Example Response:
```json
{
  "status": true,
  "data": {
    "id": "a3b8c9d0-1234-5678-9abc-def012345678",
    "plan_id": "c9fa6b09-9077-4253-b224-50b28ed9a987",
    "name": "Business Plan",
    "type": "business",
    "cycle": "monthly",
    "price": 29,
    "currency": "USD",
    "free_credits": 100,
    "max_projects": 10,
    "max_locales": 5,
    "max_users": 25,
    "max_translator_users": 10
  }
}
```

#### GET /api/projects/{projectId}/credits/transactions
Summary: Get Project Credit Transactions
Operation ID: `970dbdd4f1ed1f45f41bf9f90dd2e558`

Description: Get the credit balance of a project.

Security Requirements:
- bearerAuth

Parameters:
- `projectId` in path (Required): Id of project
  Type: string
  Example: `"10a14bd4-4e17-4524-ab06-5b3ac55f7cf9"`
- `start_date` in query: Start date for the activity range
  Type: string
  Example: `"2024-01-01"`
- `end_date` in query: End date for the activity range
  Type: string
  Example: `"2024-01-31"`
- `page` in query: Page to request
  Type: integer
  Example: `"1"`
- `records_per_page` in query: Number of records per page
  Type: integer
  Example: `"10"`
- `order_by` in query: Order results by specified field(s). Supports single field (order_by=field:direction) or multiple fields for tie-breaking (order_by[]=field1:direction&order_by[]=field2:direction).

**Orderable fields:** `created_at`, `amount`, `type`, `tier`

**Default order:** `created_at:desc`
  Type: Composition (one of)
  Example: `"created_at:desc"`
- `filter_by` in query: Filter results by field values. Supports single filter (filter_by=field:value) or multiple filters (filter_by[]=field1:value&filter_by[]=field2:value).

**Filterable fields:** `tier`, `type`

**Default filters:** none
  Type: Composition (one of)
  Example: `"tier:value"`

Responses:
- 200: Success
  Content-Type: `application/json`
  Schema:
    # Schema: BalanceTransactionPaginatedResponse
    Type: object
    Properties:
      status:
        Type: boolean
        Description: Response status
        Example: true

      page:
        Type: integer
        Description: Current page number
        Example: 1

      records_per_page:
        Type: integer
        Description: Number of records per page
        Example: 8

      page_count:
        Type: integer
        Description: Number of pages
        Example: 5

      total_records:
        Type: integer
        Description: Total number of items
        Example: 40

      data:
        Type: array
        Items: 
          allOf:
            # Schema: BalanceTransaction
            Type: object
            Properties:
              id:
                Type: string
                Description: Transaction ID
                Example: "123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174001"

              entity_id:
                Type: string
                Description: Entity ID
                Example: "123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000"

              entity_type:
                Type: string
                Description: Entity type (user, organization, project)
                Example: "user"

              amount:
                Type: string
                Description: Transaction amount
                Example: 50

              type:
                Type: string
                Enum: ["credit", "auto_recharge", "machine_translation", "draw_from_account", "draw_from_organization", "prepaid_credits_invoiced", "free_credits_granted", "machine_translation_refund", "machine_translation_topup", "prepaid_credits_transfer", "free_credits_transfer", "api_usage", "coupon_redemption"]
                Description: Transaction type
                Example: "credit"

              balance_before:
                Type: string
                Description: Balance before transaction
                Example: 50

              balance_after:
                Type: string
                Description: Balance after transaction
                Example: 50

              prepaid_credit:
                Type: boolean
                Description: Pre-paid credit
                Example: true

              reference_entity_id:
                Type: string
                Description: Reference Entity ID
                Example: "ref_123"

              reference_entity_type:
                Type: string
                Description: Reference Entity Type
                Example: "user"

              tier:
                Type: string
                Enum: ["basic", "smart", "premium"]
                Description: Translation tier (machine-translation rows only).
                Example: "smart"

              machine_translation_transaction_id:
                Type: string
                Description: Machine Translation Transaction ID
                Example: "123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174002"

              created_at:
                Type: integer
                Description: Transaction date
                Example: 1781149482



        Description: List of items

#### POST /api/projects/{projectId}/credits
Summary: Add Credit to Project
Operation ID: `f766103f244aa4d0dc98ca43999aad54`

Description: Add credit to a project's balance.

Security Requirements:
- bearerAuth

Parameters:
- `projectId` in path (Required): Id of project
  Type: string
  Example: `"10a14bd4-4e17-4524-ab06-5b3ac55f7cf9"`

Request Body:
Content-Type: `application/json`
Schema:
  # Schema: AddCreditRequest
  Type: object
  Properties:
    amount (Required):
      Type: number
      Format: float
      Description: Amount of credit to add.
      Example: 100

    cc_id:
      Type: string
      Description: The credit card id for the existing credit card
      Example: "73f3e5d8-d9e9-439f-9812-597323c064c9"

    credit_card:
      allOf:
        # Schema: CreditCardData
        Type: object
        Properties:
          cc_number:
            Type: string
            Description: Full credit card number.
            Example: "4111111111111111"

          cc_month:
            Type: string
            Description: Card expiration month (2 digits).
            Example: "02"

          cc_year:
            Type: string
            Description: Card expiration year (4 digits).
            Example: "2025"

          cc_name:
            Type: string
            Description: Cardholder name as it appears on the card.
            Example: "John Doe"

          cc_cvv:
            Type: string
            Description: Card Verification Value - the 3-digit security code on the back of most cards (4 digits on front for American Express).
            Example: "123"


      Description: The credit card data for the new credit card

    save_credit_card (Required):
      Type: boolean
      Default: true
      Description: Whether to save the credit card
      Example: true

    use_subscription_billing_address (Required):
      Type: boolean
      Default: true
      Description: Whether to use the subscription billing address in the invoice, if false, the payment method address will be used if user_organization_address is false
      Example: true

    use_organization_address (Required):
      Type: boolean
      Default: false
      Description: Whether to use the organization address in the invoice. This will only apply when adding credit to a specific organization or project
      Example: true

    user_billing_address_id:
      Type: string
      Description: ID of user billing address to use for this transaction
      Example: "3f5df782-a2a2-4124-bfcb-019d5b666bbc"

            Type: number

### Project

#### GET /api/projects
Summary: List User's Projects
Operation ID: `2ea4919d0a733012d5e30a9c60233aca`

Description: Get all projects a given user has access to. Super admins will view all projects. Pagination parameters are optional. If user locale is sent it will return project target locales as an object categorized by language and displayed in the language of {userLocale}; otherwise it will only return a plain array of locale codes. Results can be ordered by: title, description, organization_name, admin, last_activity_at, user_joined_at, created_at, updated_at, id.

Security Requirements:
- bearerAuth

Parameters:
- `visitor_locale` in query: Query parameter representing locale code to display the data in.
  Type: string
  Example: `"es-cr"`
- `page` in query: Page to request
  Type: integer
  Example: `"1"`
- `records_per_page` in query: Number of records per page
  Type: integer
  Example: `"10"`
- `filter_by` in query: Filter results by field values. Supports single filter (filter_by=field:value) or multiple filters (filter_by[]=field1:value&filter_by[]=field2:value).

**Filterable fields:** `admin`, `description`, `organization_name`, `title`

**Default filters:** none
  Type: Composition (one of)
  Example: `"admin:value"`

Responses:
- 200: Success
  Content-Type: `application/json`
  Schema:
    # Schema: ProjectPaginatedResponse
    Type: object
    Properties:
      status:
        Type: boolean
        Description: Response status
        Example: true

      page:
        Type: integer
        Description: Current page number
        Example: 1

      records_per_page:
        Type: integer
        Description: Number of records per page
        Example: 8

      page_count:
        Type: integer
        Description: Number of pages
        Example: 5

      total_records:
        Type: integer
        Description: Total number of items
        Example: 40

      data:
        Type: array
        Items: 
          allOf:
            # Schema: Project
            Type: object
            Properties:
              id:
                Type: string
                Example: "d453d230-fe8f-400e-be95-96401beb0130"

              owner_id:
                Type: string
                Example: "cf444727-9c11-4b6f-b252-22caca0d85a8"

              title:
                Type: string
                Example: "Comercado"

              description:
                Type: string
                Example: "Translations for Comercado app"

              organization_id:
                Type: string
                Description: Id of organization the project belongs to
                Example: "eff996c8-e00d-4e0c-ba92-654081f55262"

              organization_name:
                Type: string
                Example: "Ratke Ltd"

              website_url:
                Type: string
                Example: "https://example.com"

              icon:
                allOf:
                  # Schema: Photo
                  Type: object
                  Properties:
                    id:
                      Type: string
                      Example: "7c5c39d2-2c46-407d-b60b-72a7b2de63b1"

                    path:
                      Type: string
                      Description: Local path of the photo.
                      Example: "/public/images"

                    provider:
                      Type: string
                      Enum: ["gravatar", "imagekit", "custom"]
                      Example: "custom"

                    width:
                      Type: integer
                      Description: Width of the photo in pixels.
                      Example: 582

                    height:
                      Type: integer
                      Description: Height of the photo in pixels.
                      Example: 265

                    original:
                      Type: string
                      Description: Url of the original size of the photo
                      Example: "https://example.com/original.jpg"

                    medium:
                      Type: string
                      Description: Url of the medium size of the photo
                      Example: "https://example.com/medium.jpg"

                    thumb:
                      Type: string
                      Description: Url of the thumbnail size of the photo
                      Example: "https://example.com/thumb.jpg"



              logo:
                allOf:
                  # Schema: Photo
                  Type: object
                  Properties:
                    id:
                      Type: string
                      Example: "7c5c39d2-2c46-407d-b60b-72a7b2de63b1"

                    path:
                      Type: string
                      Description: Local path of the photo.
                      Example: "/public/images"

                    provider:
                      Type: string
                      Enum: ["gravatar", "imagekit", "custom"]
                      Example: "custom"

                    width:
                      Type: integer
                      Description: Width of the photo in pixels.
                      Example: 582

                    height:
                      Type: integer
                      Description: Height of the photo in pixels.
                      Example: 265

                    original:
                      Type: string
                      Description: Url of the original size of the photo
                      Example: "https://example.com/original.jpg"

                    medium:
                      Type: string
                      Description: Url of the medium size of the photo
                      Example: "https://example.com/medium.jpg"

                    thumb:
                      Type: string
                      Description: Url of the thumbnail size of the photo
                      Example: "https://example.com/thumb.jpg"



              settings:
                allOf:
                  # Schema: ProjectSettingsData
                  Type: object
                  Properties:
                    locales:
                      allOf:
                        # Schema: LocaleSettingsData
                        Type: object
                        Properties:
                          base_locale:
                            Type: string
                            Default: "en-us"
                            Description: Project wide setting that determines the base locale for the project.
                            Example: "en-us"

                          target_locales:
                            Type: array
                            Items: 
                              Type: string
                              Example: "es-cr"

                            Description: Project wide setting that determines the target locales for the project.

                          default_locales:
                            Type: object
                              (No properties defined - generic object)
                            Description: Project wide setting that determines the default locales for each language in the project.
                            Example: {"es":"es-cr"}

                          use_translation_memory:
                            Type: boolean
                            Default: true
                            Description: Project wide setting that determines whether the system should look in Translation Memory when using the translation search algorithm.
                            Example: true

                          locale_code_format:
                            Type: string
                            Enum: ["lowercase-hyphen", "bcp47", "posix"]
                            Default: "lowercase-hyphen"
                            Description: Organization wide setting that determines the format of locale codes in API responses.
                            Example: "lowercase-hyphen"



                    ai_translator:
                      allOf:
                        # Schema: AiTranslatorSettingsData
                        Type: object
                        Properties:
                          machine_translate_new_phrases:
                            Type: boolean
                            Default: true
                            Description: Project wide setting that determines whether the system should generate a machine translation for each new phrase created; this will only happen if the phrase doesnt have a translation/machine translation in the Organizations Translation Memory or if it has machine translations in the Organizations Translation Memory but the use_translation_memory setting is disabled.
                            Example: true

                          use_machine_translations:
                            Type: boolean
                            Default: true
                            Description: Project wide setting that determines whether the system should return machine translations when searching for translations through the translations endpoint.
                            Example: true

                          translate_base_locale_only:
                            Type: boolean
                            Default: false
                            Description: Project wide setting that when enabled will detect the language of your phrases before machine translating.  If it matches base_locale, it will be allowed to machine translate. If another locale is detected, the phrase will be marked to never translate automatically. Language detection may have an additional cost per phrase.  Use this option if you have mixed language content and want to be sure that other languages stay in their original form.
                            Example: true

                          tier:
                            Type: string
                            Enum: ["basic", "smart", "premium"]
                            Default: "smart"
                            Description: Translation tier — basic (Google, fastest/cheapest), smart (budget LLM, default), or premium (top-quality LLM). The underlying model is selected by langsys-ai based on the chosen tier.
                            Example: "smart"



                    billing:
                      allOf:
                        # Schema: ProjectBillingSettingsData
                        Type: object
                        Properties:
                          monthly_credit_usage_limit:
                            Type: number
                            Format: float
                            Default: 0
                            Description: Project wide setting that determines the monthly usage limit for the project. Setting to 0 is equivalent to unlimited usage.
                            Example: 20

                          auto_recharge_enabled:
                            Type: boolean
                            Default: false
                            Description: Project wide setting that determines whether the system should automatically recharge the project when the usage limit is reached.
                            Example: true

                          auto_recharge_threshold:
                            Type: number
                            Format: float
                            Default: 0
                            Description: Project wide setting that determines the threshold for automatic recharge.
                            Example: 20

                          auto_recharge_amount:
                            Type: number
                            Format: float
                            Default: 0
                            Description: Project wide setting that determines the amount to recharge.
                            Example: 20

                          auto_recharge_source:
                            Type: string
                            Enum: ["organization_balance", "credit_card", "organization_balance_or_credit_card", "credit_card_or_organization_balance"]
                            Default: "organization_balance_or_credit_card"
                            Description: Project wide setting that determines the source of the automatic recharge.
                            Example: "credit_card"





              admin:
                Type: boolean
                Example: true

              last_activity_at:
                Type: integer
                Example: 1781149482

              totals:
                allOf:
                  # Schema: GeneralProjectTotals
                  Type: object
                  Properties:
                    phrases:
                      Type: integer
                      Description: Total number of phrases in project.
                      Example: 291

                    words:
                      Type: integer
                      Description: Total number of words in project.
                      Example: 755

                    words_across_locales:
                      Type: integer
                      Description: Total translation workload in words across all target locales (words * target_locales). Not the remaining amount; see untranslated.words for words still to translate.
                      Example: 3020

                    target_locales:
                      Type: integer
                      Description: Total number of target locales the user can access. Translators can only see target locales assigned to them.
                      Example: 4



              role:
                allOf:
                  # Schema: RoleData
                  Type: object
                  Properties:
                    value:
                      Type: string
                      Description: Role value
                      Example: "organization_admin"

                    label:
                      Type: string
                      Description: Role label
                      Example: "Organization Admin"



              user_joined_at:
                Type: integer
                Description: Timestamp when the user joined the project or when they got access to it
                Example: 1781149482

              created_at:
                Type: integer
                Example: 1781149482

              updated_at:
                Type: integer
                Example: 1781149482

              deleted_at:
                Type: integer
                Example: 1781149482



        Description: List of items


  Example Response:
```json
{
  "status": true,
  "page": 1,
  "records_per_page": 8,
  "page_count": 5,
  "total_records": 40,
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "d453d230-fe8f-400e-be95-96401beb0130",
```

#### POST /api/projects
Summary: Create New Project
Operation ID: `48ad9efff74ef8cbc32998fcb386e258`

Description: Create a project in an organization.

Security Requirements:
- bearerAuth

Request Body:
Content-Type: `application/json`
Schema:
  # Schema: ProjectRequest
  Type: object
  Properties:
    organization_id (Required):
      Type: string
      Example: "f5d33e26-013e-48ee-a89c-fa7169c8ce3b"

    title (Required):
      Type: string
      Example: "Comercadoo"

    description:
      Type: string
      Example: "Translations for Comercado app"

    website_url:
      Type: string
      Example: "https://example.com"

    icon:
      allOf:
        # Schema: Photo
        Type: object
        Properties:
          id:
            Type: string
            Example: "7c5c39d2-2c46-407d-b60b-72a7b2de63b1"

          path:
            Type: string
            Description: Local path of the photo.
            Example: "/public/images"

          provider:
            Type: string
            Enum: ["gravatar", "imagekit", "custom"]
            Example: "custom"

          width:
            Type: integer
            Description: Width of the photo in pixels.
            Example: 582

          height:
            Type: integer
            Description: Height of the photo in pixels.
            Example: 265

          original:
            Type: string
            Description: Url of the original size of the photo
            Example: "https://example.com/original.jpg"

          medium:
            Type: string
            Description: Url of the medium size of the photo
            Example: "https://example.com/medium.jpg"

          thumb:
            Type: string
            Description: Url of the thumbnail size of the photo
            Example: "https://example.com/thumb.jpg"


      Description: Favicon of the project. If not provided, Langsys will attempt to fetch it from the website URL

    logo:
      allOf:
        # Schema: Photo
        Type: object
        Properties:
          id:
            Type: string
            Example: "7c5c39d2-2c46-407d-b60b-72a7b2de63b1"

          path:
            Type: string
            Description: Local path of the photo.
            Example: "/public/images"

          provider:
            Type: string
            Enum: ["gravatar", "imagekit", "custom"]
            Example: "custom"

          width:
            Type: integer
            Description: Width of the photo in pixels.
            Example: 582

          height:
            Type: integer
            Description: Height of the photo in pixels.
            Example: 265

          original:
            Type: string
            Description: Url of the original size of the photo
            Example: "https://example.com/original.jpg"

          medium:
            Type: string
            Description: Url of the medium size of the photo
            Example: "https://example.com/medium.jpg"

          thumb:
            Type: string
            Description: Url of the thumbnail size of the photo
            Example: "https://example.com/thumb.jpg"


      Description: Logo of the project. If not provided, Langsys will attempt to fetch it from the website URL

    settings:
      allOf:
        # Schema: ProjectSettingsData
        Type: object
        Properties:
          locales:
            allOf:
              # Schema: LocaleSettingsData
              Type: object
              Properties:
                base_locale:
                  Type: string
                  Default: "en-us"
                  Description: Project wide setting that determines the base locale for the project.
                  Example: "en-us"

                target_locales:
                  Type: array
                  Items: 
                    Type: string
                    Example: "es-cr"

                  Description: Project wide setting that determines the target locales for the project.

                default_locales:
                  Type: object
                    (No properties defined - generic object)
                  Description: Project wide setting that determines the default locales for each language in the project.
                  Example: {"es":"es-cr"}

                use_translation_memory:
                  Type: boolean
                  Default: true
                  Description: Project wide setting that determines whether the system should look in Translation Memory when using the translation search algorithm.
                  Example: true

                locale_code_format:
                  Type: string
                  Enum: ["lowercase-hyphen", "bcp47", "posix"]
                  Default: "lowercase-hyphen"
                  Description: Organization wide setting that determines the format of locale codes in API responses.
                  Example: "lowercase-hyphen"



          ai_translator:
            allOf:
              # Schema: AiTranslatorSettingsData
              Type: object
              Properties:
                machine_translate_new_phrases:
                  Type: boolean
                  Default: true
                  Description: Project wide setting that determines whether the system should generate a machine translation for each new phrase created; this will only happen if the phrase doesnt have a translation/machine translation in the Organizations Translation Memory or if it has machine translations in the Organizations Translation Memory but the use_translation_memory setting is disabled.
                  Example: true

                use_machine_translations:
                  Type: boolean
                  Default: true
                  Description: Project wide setting that determines whether the system should return machine translations when searching for translations through the translations endpoint.
                  Example: true

                translate_base_locale_only:
                  Type: boolean
                  Default: false
                  Description: Project wide setting that when enabled will detect the language of your phrases before machine translating.  If it matches base_locale, it will be allowed to machine translate. If another locale is detected, the phrase will be marked to never translate automatically. Language detection may have an additional cost per phrase.  Use this option if you have mixed language content and want to be sure that other languages stay in their original form.
                  Example: true

                tier:
                  Type: string
                  Enum: ["basic", "smart", "premium"]
                  Default: "smart"
                  Description: Translation tier — basic (Google, fastest/cheapest), smart (budget LLM, default), or premium (top-quality LLM). The underlying model is selected by langsys-ai based on the chosen tier.
                  Example: "smart"



          billing:
            allOf:
              # Schema: ProjectBillingSettingsData
              Type: object
              Properties:
                monthly_credit_usage_limit:
                  Type: number
                  Format: float
                  Default: 0
                  Description: Project wide setting that determines the monthly usage limit for the project. Setting to 0 is equivalent to unlimited usage.
                  Example: 20

                auto_recharge_enabled:
                  Type: boolean
                  Default: false
                  Description: Project wide setting that determines whether the system should automatically recharge the project when the usage limit is reached.
                  Example: true

                auto_recharge_threshold:
                  Type: number
                  Format: float
                  Default: 0
                  Description: Project wide setting that determines the threshold for automatic recharge.
                  Example: 20

                auto_recharge_amount:
                  Type: number
                  Format: float
                  Default: 0
                  Description: Project wide setting that determines the amount to recharge.
                  Example: 20

                auto_recharge_source:
                  Type: string
                  Enum: ["organization_balance", "credit_card", "organization_balance_or_credit_card", "credit_card_or_organization_balance"]
                  Default: "organization_balance_or_credit_card"
                  Description: Project wide setting that determines the source of the automatic recharge.
                  Example: "credit_card"




      Description: If the project does not have these settings set specifically for it, then its organization settings will be used instead.

#### DELETE /api/projects/{projectId}
Summary: Delete Project
Operation ID: `a8f94758a675b19c8261a049d7fc31f3`

Description: Delete a project. Optionally transfer all phrases and translations to another project before deletion.

Security Requirements:
- bearerAuth

Parameters:
- `projectId` in path (Required): Id of project
  Type: string
  Example: `"10a14bd4-4e17-4524-ab06-5b3ac55f7cf9"`

Request Body:
Content-Type: `application/json`
Schema:
  # Schema: DeleteProjectRequest
  Type: object
  Properties:
    target_project_id:
      Type: string
      Description: Project ID to transfer phrases to before deletion. If not provided, phrases will be deleted.
      Example: "d688dfb5-fe21-41f4-9c08-ba4a159a0193"

    include_translations:
      Type: boolean
      Default: false
      Description: Whether to also transfer translations.
      Example: true

    create_target_locales:
      Type: boolean
      Default: false
      Description: Whether to create target locales in target project if they do not exist. If false, only translations to existing locales will be transferred.
      Example: true

    force_transfer:
      Type: boolean
      Default: false
      Description: Force transfer even if projects base locale does not match.
      Example: true

#### GET /api/projects/{projectId}/stats
Summary: Get Project Statistics
Operation ID: `c6917b81969d34b735d9b731f7dc1dd8`

Description: Get a detailed stats about a project's phrases and translations.

Security Requirements:
- bearerAuth

Parameters:
- `projectId` in path (Required): Id of project
  Type: string
  Example: `"10a14bd4-4e17-4524-ab06-5b3ac55f7cf9"`

Responses:
- 200: Success
  Content-Type: `application/json`
  Schema:
    # Schema: ProjectTotalsResponse
    Type: object
    Properties:
      status:
        Type: boolean
        Description: Response status
        Example: true

      data:
        # Inferred schema: ProjectTotals
        # Schema: ProjectTotals
        Type: object
        Properties:
          phrases:
            Type: integer
            Description: Total number of phrases in project.
            Example: 291

          words:
            Type: integer
            Description: Total number of words in project.
            Example: 755

          words_across_locales:
            Type: integer
            Description: Total translation workload in words across all target locales (words * target_locales). Not the remaining amount; see untranslated.words for words still to translate.
            Example: 3020

          target_locales:
            Type: integer
            Description: Total number of target locales the user can access. Translators can only see target locales assigned to them.
            Example: 4

          translated_target_locales:
            Type: integer
            Description: Total number of locales for which translations exist.
            Example: 3

          translations:
            allOf:
              # Schema: GlobalTranslationTotals
              Type: object
              Properties:
                total:
                  Type: integer
                  Description: Total number of translations in project.
                  Example: 712

                human:
                  Type: integer
                  Description: Total number of human translations in project.
                  Example: 618

                ai:
                  Type: integer
                  Description: Total number of ai translations in project.
                  Example: 94

                words:
                  allOf:
                    # Schema: WordTranslationTotals
                    Type: object
                    Properties:
                      total:
                        Type: integer
                        Description: Total number of words translated in project.
                        Example: 803

                      human:
                        Type: integer
                        Description: Total number of human translations in project.
                        Example: 778

                      ai:
                        Type: integer
                        Description: Total number of ai translations in project.
                        Example: 25



                locales:
                  Type: object
                    (No properties defined - generic object)


            Description: Translations totals further separated into human vs ai, and also grouped by locale.

          my_translations:
            allOf:
              # Schema: TotalsWithLocales
              Type: object
              Properties:
                total:
                  Type: integer
                  Example: 311

                words:
                  Type: integer
                  Example: 801

                locales:
                  Type: object
                    (No properties defined - generic object)


            Description: Translations made by user in the project and also grouped by locale.

          untranslated:
            allOf:
              # Schema: TotalsWithLocales
              Type: object
              Properties:
                total:
                  Type: integer
                  Example: 311

                words:
                  Type: integer
                  Example: 801

                locales:
                  Type: object
                    (No properties defined - generic object)


            Description: Untranslated phrases in project and also grouped by locale.



  Example Response:
```json
{
  "status": true,
  "data": {
    "phrases": 291,
    "words": 755,
    "words_across_locales": 3020,
    "target_locales": 4,
    "translated_target_locales": 3,
    "translations": {
      "total": 712,
      "human": 618,
      "ai": 94,
      "words": {
        "total": 803,
        "human": 778,
        "ai": 25
      },
      "locales": {}
    },
    "my_translations": {
      "total": 311,
      "words": 801,
      "locales": {}
    },
    "untranslated": {
      "total": 311,
      "words": 801,
      "locales": {}
    }
  }
}
```

#### GET /api/projects/{projectId}/billing/payment-methods
Summary: List Project Payment Methods
Operation ID: `ea8112dead6bf628dc4c04b104169887`

Description: Get a list of payment methods associated with this project.

Security Requirements:
- bearerAuth

Parameters:
- `projectId` in path (Required): Id of project
  Type: string
  Example: `"10a14bd4-4e17-4524-ab06-5b3ac55f7cf9"`

Responses:
- 200: Success
  Content-Type: `application/json`
  Schema:
    # Schema: PaymentMethodListResponse
    Type: object
    Properties:
      status:
        Type: boolean

        Example: true

      data:
        Type: array
        Items: 
          allOf:
            # Schema: PaymentMethod
            Type: object
            Properties:
              id:
                Type: string
                Description: Credit card id.
                Example: "19b3b92a-3399-4a3f-a121-afbd89a75d22"

              cc_mask:
                Type: string
                Description: Masked credit card number.
                Example: "4111-1111-1111-1111"

              cc_brand:
                Type: string
                Description: Type of card.
                Example: "VISA"

              cc_name:
                Type: string
                Description: Name on the credit card.
                Example: "Joe Doe"

              alias:
                Type: string
                Description: Alias/nickname for the payment method.
                Example: "My Work Card"

              cc_month:
                Type: string
                Description: Expiration month.
                Example: "01"

              cc_year:
                Type: string
                Description: Expiration year.
                Example: "2025"

              address_1:
                Type: string
                Description: Primary billing address line
                Example: "Guachipelín de Escazú"

              address_2:
                Type: string
                Description: Secondary billing address line
                Example: "Ofibodegas #5"

              city:
                Type: string
                Description: City
                Example: "Escazú"

              state:
                Type: string
                Description: State/Province
                Example: "San José"

              zip:
                Type: string
                Description: ZIP/Postal code
                Example: "10203"

              country_code:
                Type: string
                Description: Country code
                Example: "CR"

              owner_id:
                Type: string
                Example: "d6b47319-313e-466e-8f00-abe14b7810ba"

              is_default_for_context:
                Type: boolean
                Description: Is default payment method for the current context (organization/project).
                Example: "true"

### Project - Reports

#### GET /api/projects/{projectId}/reports/machine-translation-transactions
Summary: Get Project Translation Transactions
Operation ID: `d53c183122173d14611357cc88833b37`

Description: Get machine translation transactions for a specific project. Optionally filter by user ID, locale code, machine translator and date range.

Security Requirements:
- bearerAuth

Parameters:
- `projectId` in path (Required): Id of project
  Type: string
  Example: `"10a14bd4-4e17-4524-ab06-5b3ac55f7cf9"`
- `start_date` in query: Start date for the activity range
  Type: string
  Example: `"2024-01-01"`
- `end_date` in query: End date for the activity range
  Type: string
  Example: `"2024-01-31"`
- `page` in query: Page to request
  Type: integer
  Example: `"1"`
- `records_per_page` in query: Number of records per page
  Type: integer
  Example: `"10"`
- `order_by` in query: Order results by specified field(s). Supports single field (order_by=field:direction) or multiple fields for tie-breaking (order_by[]=field1:direction&order_by[]=field2:direction).

**Orderable fields:** `amount`, `translator`, `created_at`

**Default order:** `created_at:desc`
  Type: Composition (one of)
  Example: `"created_at:desc"`
- `filter_by` in query: Filter results by field values. Supports single filter (filter_by=field:value) or multiple filters (filter_by[]=field1:value&filter_by[]=field2:value).

**Default filters:** none
  Type: Composition (one of)
  Example: `"field:value"`

Responses:
- 200: Success
  Content-Type: `application/json`
  Schema:
    # Schema: MachineTranslationTransactionResponse
    Type: object
    Properties:
      status:
        Type: boolean
        Description: Response status
        Example: true

      data:
        # Inferred schema: MachineTranslationTransaction
        # Schema: MachineTranslationTransaction
        Type: object
        Properties:
          id:
            Type: string
            Example: "d37eeeb7-75c2-4d5c-b02d-5af414b8d649"

          phrase_id:
            Type: string
            Description: Phrase ID.
            Example: "2c558493-3b75-44fb-952d-bcb40b177a45"

          tier:
            Type: string
            Enum: ["basic", "smart", "premium"]
            Description: Translation tier requested for this transaction.
            Example: "smart"

          machine_translator:
            Type: string
            Enum: ["google/translate", "amazon/translate", "deepl/translate", "openai/gpt-4o-mini", "openai/gpt-4o", "openai/gpt-4.1", "openai/gpt-5-chat", "anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5", "anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.6", "anthropic/claude-opus-4.5", "anthropic/claude-opus-4.7", "x-ai/grok-beta"]
            Description: Underlying machine translator/model langsys-ai used to fulfill the tier.
            Example: "openai/gpt-4.1"

          user_id:
            Type: string
            Description: User that executed the machine translation.
            Example: "9246b4f1-a0c9-440a-96c9-37c9365192c6"

          locale_code:
            Type: string
            Description: Machine translation locale.
            Example: "es-es"

          phrases:
            Type: integer
            Description: Total number of phrases translated in transaction.
            Example: 13

          words:
            Type: integer
            Description: Total number of words translated in transaction.
            Example: 152

          billing_amount:
            Type: number
            Format: float
            Description: Total billing amount for transaction.
            Example: 152

          date:
            Type: integer
            Description: Machine translation transaction date.
            Example: 1781149482



  Example Response:
```json
{
  "status": true,
  "data": {
    "id": "d37eeeb7-75c2-4d5c-b02d-5af414b8d649",
    "phrase_id": "2c558493-3b75-44fb-952d-bcb40b177a45",
    "tier": "smart",
    "machine_translator": "openai/gpt-4.1",

  }
}
```

### Project - Settings

#### PATCH /api/projects/{projectId}/settings
Summary: Set Project Settings
Operation ID: `adac0038f3b9f18363aade36f4b5d004`

Description: Set the settings for a project.

Security Requirements:
- bearerAuth

Parameters:
- `projectId` in path (Required): Id of project
  Type: string
  Example: `"10a14bd4-4e17-4524-ab06-5b3ac55f7cf9"`

Request Body:
Content-Type: `application/json`
Schema:
  # Schema: ProjectSettingsRequest
  Type: object
  Properties:
    locales:
      allOf:
        # Schema: LocaleSettingsData
        Type: object
        Properties:
          base_locale:
            Type: string
            Default: "en-us"
            Description: Project wide setting that determines the base locale for the project.
            Example: "en-us"

          target_locales:
            Type: array
            Items: 
              Type: string
              Example: "es-cr"

            Description: Project wide setting that determines the target locales for the project.

          default_locales:
            Type: object
              (No properties defined - generic object)
            Description: Project wide setting that determines the default locales for each language in the project.
            Example: {"es":"es-cr"}

          use_translation_memory:
            Type: boolean
            Default: true
            Description: Project wide setting that determines whether the system should look in Translation Memory when using the translation search algorithm.
            Example: true

          locale_code_format:
            Type: string
            Enum: ["lowercase-hyphen", "bcp47", "posix"]
            Default: "lowercase-hyphen"
            Description: Organization wide setting that determines the format of locale codes in API responses.
            Example: "lowercase-hyphen"



    ai_translator:
      allOf:
        # Schema: AiTranslatorSettingsData
        Type: object
        Properties:
          machine_translate_new_phrases:
            Type: boolean
            Default: true
            Description: Project wide setting that determines whether the system should generate a machine translation for each new phrase created; this will only happen if the phrase doesnt have a translation/machine translation in the Organizations Translation Memory or if it has machine translations in the Organizations Translation Memory but the use_translation_memory setting is disabled.
            Example: true

          use_machine_translations:
            Type: boolean
            Default: true
            Description: Project wide setting that determines whether the system should return machine translations when searching for translations through the translations endpoint.
            Example: true

          translate_base_locale_only:
            Type: boolean
            Default: false
            Description: Project wide setting that when enabled will detect the language of your phrases before machine translating.  If it matches base_locale, it will be allowed to machine translate. If another locale is detected, the phrase will be marked to never translate automatically. Language detection may have an additional cost per phrase.  Use this option if you have mixed language content and want to be sure that other languages stay in their original form.
            Example: true

          tier:
            Type: string
            Enum: ["basic", "smart", "premium"]
            Default: "smart"
            Description: Translation tier — basic (Google, fastest/cheapest), smart (budget LLM, default), or premium (top-quality LLM). The underlying model is selected by langsys-ai based on the chosen tier.
            Example: "smart"



    billing:
      allOf:
        # Schema: ProjectBillingSettingsData
        Type: object
        Properties:
          monthly_credit_usage_limit:
            Type: number
            Format: float
            Default: 0
            Description: Project wide setting that determines the monthly usage limit for the project. Setting to 0 is equivalent to unlimited usage.
            Example: 20

          auto_recharge_enabled:
            Type: boolean
            Default: false
            Description: Project wide setting that determines whether the system should automatically recharge the project when the usage limit is reached.
            Example: true

          auto_recharge_threshold:
            Type: number
            Format: float
            Default: 0
            Description: Project wide setting that determines the threshold for automatic recharge.
            Example: 20

          auto_recharge_amount:
            Type: number
            Format: float
            Default: 0
            Description: Project wide setting that determines the amount to recharge.
            Example: 20

          auto_recharge_source:
            Type: string
            Enum: ["organization_balance", "credit_card", "organization_balance_or_credit_card", "credit_card_or_organization_balance"]
            Default: "organization_balance_or_credit_card"
            Description: Project wide setting that determines the source of the automatic recharge.
            Example: "credit_card"





Responses:
- 200: success
  Content-Type: `application/json`
  Schema:
    # Schema: ProjectSettingsResponse
    Type: object
    Properties:
      status:
        Type: boolean
        Description: Response status
        Example: true

      data:
        # Inferred schema: ProjectSettings
        # Schema: ProjectSettings
        Type: object
        Properties:
          locales:
            allOf:
              # Schema: LocaleSettingsData
              Type: object
              Properties:
                base_locale:
                  Type: string
                  Default: "en-us"
                  Description: Project wide setting that determines the base locale for the project.
                  Example: "en-us"

                target_locales:
                  Type: array
                  Items: 
                    Type: string
                    Example: "es-cr"

                  Description: Project wide setting that determines the target locales for the project.

                default_locales:
                  Type: object
                    (No properties defined - generic object)
                  Description: Project wide setting that determines the default locales for each language in the project.
                  Example: {"es":"es-cr"}

                use_translation_memory:
                  Type: boolean
                  Default: true
                  Description: Project wide setting that determines whether the system should look in Translation Memory when using the translation search algorithm.
                  Example: true

                locale_code_format:
                  Type: string
                  Enum: ["lowercase-hyphen", "bcp47", "posix"]
                  Default: "lowercase-hyphen"
                  Description: Organization wide setting that determines the format of locale codes in API responses.
                  Example: "lowercase-hyphen"



          ai_translator:
            allOf:
              # Schema: AiTranslatorSettingsData
              Type: object
              Properties:
                machine_translate_new_phrases:
                  Type: boolean
                  Default: true
                  Description: Project wide setting that determines whether the system should generate a machine translation for each new phrase created; this will only happen if the phrase doesnt have a translation/machine translation in the Organizations Translation Memory or if it has machine translations in the Organizations Translation Memory but the use_translation_memory setting is disabled.
                  Example: true

                use_machine_translations:
                  Type: boolean
                  Default: true
                  Description: Project wide setting that determines whether the system should return machine translations when searching for translations through the translations endpoint.
                  Example: true

                translate_base_locale_only:
                  Type: boolean
                  Default: false
                  Description: Project wide setting that when enabled will detect the language of your phrases before machine translating.  If it matches base_locale, it will be allowed to machine translate. If another locale is detected, the phrase will be marked to never translate automatically. Language detection may have an additional cost per phrase.  Use this option if you have mixed language content and want to be sure that other languages stay in their original form.
                  Example: true

                tier:
                  Type: string
                  Enum: ["basic", "smart", "premium"]
                  Default: "smart"
                  Description: Translation tier — basic (Google, fastest/cheapest), smart (budget LLM, default), or premium (top-quality LLM). The underlying model is selected by langsys-ai based on the chosen tier.
                  Example: "smart"



          billing:
            allOf:
              # Schema: ProjectBillingSettingsData
              Type: object
              Properties:
                monthly_credit_usage_limit:
                  Type: number
                  Format: float
                  Default: 0
                  Description: Project wide setting that determines the monthly usage limit for the project. Setting to 0 is equivalent to unlimited usage.
                  Example: 20

                auto_recharge_enabled:
                  Type: boolean
                  Default: false
                  Description: Project wide setting that determines whether the system should automatically recharge the project when the usage limit is reached.
                  Example: true

                auto_recharge_threshold:
                  Type: number
                  Format: float
                  Default: 0
                  Description: Project wide setting that determines the threshold for automatic recharge.
                  Example: 20

                auto_recharge_amount:
                  Type: number
                  Format: float
                  Default: 0
                  Description: Project wide setting that determines the amount to recharge.
                  Example: 20

                auto_recharge_source:
                  Type: string
                  Enum: ["organization_balance", "credit_card", "organization_balance_or_credit_card", "credit_card_or_organization_balance"]
                  Default: "organization_balance_or_credit_card"
                  Description: Project wide setting that determines the source of the automatic recharge.
                  Example: "credit_card"





  Example Response:
```json
{
  "status": true,
  "data": {
    "locales": {
      "base_locale": "en-us",
      "target_locales": [
        "es-cr"
      ],
      "default_locales": {
        "es": "es-cr"
      },
      "use_translation_memory": true,
      "locale_code_format": "lowercase-hyphen"

      "tier": "smart"
    },

}
```

#### DELETE /api/projects/{projectId}/locale-settings
Summary: Clear Project Locale Settings Override
Operation ID: `cbb949c896a03d04560c2721db6e0443`

Description: Clear the override locale settings for a project. This will clear the locale settings that are overridden for the project, effectively setting it back to its organization's locale settings.

#### GET /api/projects/{projectId}/ai-translator-settings
Summary: Get Project AI Translator Settings
Operation ID: `99f0ea4f0914ba71ff7753e2701b6266`

Description: Get the override AI translator settings for a project. This will return the AI translator settings that are overridden for the project or an empty object if no settings are overridden for the project. Empty object means that the project is inheriting its AI translator settings from the organization.

Security Requirements:
- bearerAuth

Parameters:
- `projectId` in path (Required): Id of project
  Type: string
  Example: `"10a14bd4-4e17-4524-ab06-5b3ac55f7cf9"`

Responses:
- 200: success
  Content-Type: `application/json`
  Schema:
    # Schema: AiTranslatorSettingsResponse
    Type: object
    Properties:
      status:
        Type: boolean
        Description: Response status
        Example: true

      data:
        # Inferred schema: AiTranslatorSettings
        # Schema: AiTranslatorSettings
        Type: object
        Properties:
          machine_translate_new_phrases:
            Type: boolean
            Default: true
            Description: Project wide setting that determines whether the system should generate a machine translation for each new phrase created; this will only happen if the phrase doesnt have a translation/machine translation in the Organizations Translation Memory or if it has machine translations in the Organizations Translation Memory but the use_translation_memory setting is disabled.
            Example: true

          use_machine_translations:
            Type: boolean
            Default: true
            Description: Project wide setting that determines whether the system should return machine translations when searching for translations through the translations endpoint.
            Example: true

          translate_base_locale_only:
            Type: boolean
            Default: false
            Description: Project wide setting that when enabled will detect the language of your phrases before machine translating.  If it matches base_locale, it will be allowed to machine translate. If another locale is detected, the phrase will be marked to never translate automatically. Language detection may have an additional cost per phrase.  Use this option if you have mixed language content and want to be sure that other languages stay in their original form.
            Example: true

          tier:
            Type: string
            Enum: ["basic", "smart", "premium"]
            Default: "smart"
            Description: Translation tier — basic (Google, fastest/cheapest), smart (budget LLM, default), or premium (top-quality LLM). The underlying model is selected by langsys-ai based on the chosen tier.
            Example: "smart"



  Example Response:
```json
{
  "status": true,
  "data": {
    "machine_translate_new_phrases": true,
    "use_machine_translations": true,
    "translate_base_locale_only": true,
    "tier": "smart"
  }
}
```
- 401: error
  Content-Type: `application/json`
  Schema:

    Type: object

      error:
        Type: string
        Default: "Unauthorized"
        Description: Error description

      code:
        Type: integer
        Default: 401
        Description: Error Code


  Example Response:
```json
{
  "error": "string",
  "code": 1
}
```
- 422: error
  Content-Type: `application/json`
  Schema:
    # Schema: UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY_ERROR
    Type: object

      error:
        Type: string
        Default: "Unprocessable Entity"
        Description: Error description

      code:
        Type: integer
        Default: 422
        Description: Error Code

```json
  "code": 1
```

#### GET /api/projects/{projectId}/billing-settings
Summary: Get Project Billing Settings
Operation ID: `241996413bc3ea85949fa09c9debec44`

Description: Get the override billing settings for a project. This will return the billing settings that are overridden for the project or an empty object if no settings are overridden for the project. Empty object means that the project is inheriting its billing settings from the organization.

Security Requirements:
- bearerAuth

Parameters:
- `projectId` in path (Required): Id of project
  Type: string
  Example: `"10a14bd4-4e17-4524-ab06-5b3ac55f7cf9"`

Responses:
- 200: success
  Content-Type: `application/json`
  Schema:
    # Schema: ProjectBillingSettingsResponse
    Type: object
    Properties:
      status:
        Type: boolean
        Description: Response status
        Example: true

      data:
        # Inferred schema: ProjectBillingSettings
        # Schema: ProjectBillingSettings
        Type: object
        Properties:
          monthly_credit_usage_limit:
            Type: number
            Format: float
            Default: 0
            Description: Project wide setting that determines the monthly usage limit for the project. Setting to 0 is equivalent to unlimited usage.
            Example: 20

          auto_recharge_enabled:
            Type: boolean
            Default: false
            Description: Project wide setting that determines whether the system should automatically recharge the project when the usage limit is reached.
            Example: true

          auto_recharge_threshold:
            Type: number
            Format: float
            Default: 0
            Description: Project wide setting that determines the threshold for automatic recharge.
            Example: 20

          auto_recharge_amount:
            Type: number
            Format: float
            Default: 0
            Description: Project wide setting that determines the amount to recharge.
            Example: 20

          auto_recharge_source:
            Type: string
            Enum: ["organization_balance", "credit_card", "organization_balance_or_credit_card", "credit_card_or_organization_balance"]
            Default: "organization_balance_or_credit_card"
            Description: Project wide setting that determines the source of the automatic recharge.
            Example: "credit_card"



  Example Response:
```json

  "status": true,
  "data": {
    "monthly_credit_usage_limit": 20,
    "auto_recharge_enabled": true,
```
