    Example: "es-es"

  category:
    Type: string
    Description: Phrase or content block context category.
    Example: "UI"

  translation_id:
    Type: string
    Description: This field will be null if the request is for a content block.
    Example: "77403616-dd74-4e0c-a772-8956413e95c5"

  content_block_id:
    Type: string
    Description: This field will be null if the request is for a single phrase.
    Example: "6f11c27e-f9f1-4d8d-a9b2-7923eb56c38b"

  phrase:
    Type: string
    Description: Phrase text. This field will be null if the request is for a content block.
    Example: "About"

  phrase_id:
    Type: string
    Description: Phrase id. This field will be null if the request is for a content block.
    Example: "873bab0e-2e25-4027-ab6d-a86963e932df"

  translation:
    Type: string
    Description: Translation text in the locale requested. This field will be null if the request is for a content block.
    Example: "Nosotros"

  words:
    Type: integer
    Default: 0
    Example: 1

  translations:
    Type: array
    Items: 
      allOf:
        Reference to: `TranslationWithPhrase`

    Description: List of translations for content block. This field will be null if the request is for a single phrase.

  untranslated:
    Type: boolean
    Default: false
    Example: true

  translatable:
    Type: boolean
    Default: false
    Description: Whether phrase is translatable to other languages. For example, brand names are mostly not translatable as they consist of the same text in any language.
    Example: true

  restorable:
    Type: boolean
    Default: false
    Description: Whether this phrase is able to be restored after being marked as untranslatable.
    Example: false

  human_translated:
    Type: boolean
    Default: false
    Description: Whether translation was done by a human.
    Example: true

  memory_translated:
    Type: boolean
    Default: false
    Description: Whether translation comes from translation memory.
    Example: true

  ai_translated:
    Type: boolean
    Default: false
    Description: Whether translation is translated by AI.
    Example: false

### Plan

Type: object
Properties:
  id:
    Type: string
    Description: Plan cycle ID (one pricing row per plan + cycle combination).
    Example: "a3b8c9d0-1234-5678-9abc-def012345678"

  plan_id:
    Type: string
    Description: Parent plan ID.
    Example: "c9fa6b09-9077-4253-b224-50b28ed9a987"

  name:
    Type: string
    Description: Display name of the plan.
    Example: "Business Plan"

  type:
    Type: string
    Enum: ["free", "business"]
    Description: Type of the plan.
    Example: "business"

  cycle:
    Type: string
    Enum: ["monthly", "quarterly", "biannual", "yearly", "lifetime"]
    Description: Billing cycle for this pricing row.
    Example: "monthly"

  price:
    Type: number
    Format: float
    Description: Price for this cycle. Null when the cycle is free.
    Example: 29

  currency:
    Type: string
    Description: ISO 4217 currency code for the price.
    Example: "USD"

  free_credits:
    Type: number
    Format: float
    Description: Free credits granted to a new subscription on this cycle.
    Example: 100

  max_projects:
    Type: integer
    Description: Maximum number of projects allowed for this plan.
    Example: 10

  max_locales:
    Type: integer
    Description: Maximum number of locales allowed for this plan.
    Example: 5

  max_users:
    Type: integer
    Description: Maximum number of users allowed for this plan.
    Example: 25

  max_translator_users:
    Type: integer
    Description: Maximum number of translator users allowed for this plan.
    Example: 10

### TranslationWithPhrase

Type: object
Properties:
  id:
    Type: string
    Example: "d5dff944-a088-4cab-8fee-e929fc57147c"

  translation_id:
    Type: string
    Example: "3a62cefd-bd9e-4f01-b5db-9f0a6636d038"

  label:
    Type: string
    Description: Sanitized phrase truncated to 25 chars.
    Example: "Home"

  locale:
    Type: string
    Example: "es-es"

  category:
    Type: string
    Description: Phrase context category.
    Example: "UI"

  phrase:
    Type: string
    Example: "Home"

  phrase_id:
    Type: string
    Example: "7588946e-a393-4766-8ae6-aeaee93f9069"

  content_block_id:
    Type: string
    Example: "5dd15973-9196-4f9b-878a-eb12472a06a9"

  translation:
    Type: string
    Description: Translation text in the locale provided in this response.
    Example: "Inicio"

  untranslated:
    Type: boolean
    Example: true

  translatable:
    Type: boolean
    Description: Whether phrase is translatable to other languages. For example, brand names are mostly not translatable as they consist of the same text in any language.
    Example: true

  restorable:
    Type: boolean
    Description: Whether this phrase is able to be restored after being marked as untranslatable.
    Example: false

  human_translated:
    Type: boolean
    Description: Whether translation was done by a human.
    Example: true

  memory_translated:
    Type: boolean
    Description: Whether translation comes from translation memory.
    Example: true

  ai_translated:
    Type: boolean
    Description: Whether translation is translated by AI.
    Example: false

  translator:
    allOf:
      Reference to: `UserSimple`
    Description: User that translated the phrase.

  tier:
    Type: string
    Enum: ["basic", "smart", "premium"]
    Description: Translation tier used for this phrase.
    Example: "smart"

  machine_translator:
    Type: string
    Enum: ["google/translate", "amazon/translate", "deepl/translate", "openai/gpt-4o-mini", "openai/gpt-4o", "openai/gpt-4.1", "openai/gpt-5-chat", "anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5", "anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.6", "anthropic/claude-opus-4.5", "anthropic/claude-opus-4.7", "x-ai/grok-beta"]
    Description: Underlying machine translator/model used to translate the phrase.
    Example: "openai/gpt-4.1"

  words:
    Type: integer
    Example: 1

  created_at:
    Type: integer
    Example: 1781149482

  updated_at:
    Type: integer
    Example: 1781149482

  deleted_at:
    Type: integer
    Example: 1781149482

### AiTranslatorSettings

Type: object
Properties:
  machine_translate_new_phrases:
    Type: boolean
    Default: true
    Description: Project wide setting that determines whether the system should generate a machine translation for each new phrase created; this will only happen if the phrase doesnt have a translation/machine translation in the Organizations Translation Memory or if it has machine translations in the Organizations Translation Memory but the use_translation_memory setting is disabled.
    Example: true

  use_machine_translations:
    Type: boolean
    Default: true
    Description: Project wide setting that determines whether the system should return machine translations when searching for translations through the translations endpoint.
    Example: true

  translate_base_locale_only:
    Type: boolean
    Default: false
    Description: Project wide setting that when enabled will detect the language of your phrases before machine translating.  If it matches base_locale, it will be allowed to machine translate. If another locale is detected, the phrase will be marked to never translate automatically. Language detection may have an additional cost per phrase.  Use this option if you have mixed language content and want to be sure that other languages stay in their original form.
    Example: true

  tier:
    Type: string
    Enum: ["basic", "smart", "premium"]
    Default: "smart"
    Description: Translation tier — basic (Google, fastest/cheapest), smart (budget LLM, default), or premium (top-quality LLM). The underlying model is selected by langsys-ai based on the chosen tier.
    Example: "smart"

  transfer_mode:

    Default: "move"
    Description: Transfer mode: copy (default) keeps items in source project, move removes them from source project.
    Example: "copy"

### TranslatableItemRequest

Type: object
Properties:
  type:
    Type: string
    Enum: ["phrase", "content_block"]
    Default: "phrase"
    Example: "phrase"

  phrase:
    Type: string
    Description: The phrase text. Required when type is phrase.
    Example: "Home"

  category:
    Type: string
    Description: The category. For phrases, this is the phrase category. For content blocks, this is the content block category.
    Example: "UI"

  translatable:
    Type: boolean
    Default: true
    Description: Whether to mark the phrase as translatable. Only used when type is phrase.
    Example: true

  use_category_as_machine_translation_context:
    Type: boolean
    Description: Whether the category should be passed to the machine translator as additional context. For a standalone phrase it controls that phrase; for a content block it controls all child phrases unless they override the value on their own. Defaults to true when omitted.
    Example: true

  phrases:
    Type: array
    Items: 
      allOf:
        Reference to: `ContentBlockPhraseRequest`

    Description: List of phrases for the content block. Required when type is content_block.

  custom_id:
    Type: string
    Description: Custom id generated by the client to represent and manipulate the content block. Required when type is content_block.
    Example: "c71b773e-89e9-45fd-bba9-25b5ec571997"

  content:
    Type: string
    Description: The html content of the content block. Required when type is content_block.
    Example: "<ul><li>Home</li><li>About</li></ul>"

  label:
    Type: string
    Description: Label to identify the content block. If left empty then the first phrase with at least 5 chars will be chosen as the label.
    Example: "Main Menu"

### TranslationCreateRequest

Type: object
Properties:
  locale (Required):
    Type: string
    Description: Translation locale.
    Example: "es-es"

  translation:
    Type: string
    Description: Translation in queried locale. Only required if translatable is true and request is for a single phrase; otherwise this field will be ignored.
    Example: "Inicio"

  updateTM:
    Type: boolean
    Default: false
    Description: Whether to save this translation in translation memory.
    Example: true

  translatable:
    Type: boolean
    Default: true
    Description: If this flag is false, the translatable item will be marked as untranslatable for requested locale and all project target locales of the same language the requesting user has access to.
    Example: true

  translations:
    Type: array
    Items: 
      allOf:
        Reference to: `TranslationData`

    Description: List of translations for content block. Should be used when translatable item is a content block, unless marking all phrases inside the content block as untranslatable. In that case the translatable field sibling to this one must be set to false and this field can be left empty.

### CreditCardRequest

    Example: "John Doe"

    Type: string

    Example: "02"

  cc_year (Required):
    Type: string
    Description: Card expiration year (4 digits).

    Type: boolean
    Description: Auto-generate alias if not provided.
    Example: false

    Type: string
    Description: Card Verification Value - the 3-digit security code on the back of most cards (4 digits on front for American Express).
    Example: "123"

  country_code:
    Type: string
    Description: Two-letter ISO country code where the card was issued or the billing address is located.
    Example: "US"

  billing_address:
    allOf:
      Reference to: `BillingAddressData`
    Description: Billing address information

  is_default:
    Type: boolean
    Default: false
    Description: Set this card as the default payment method.
    Example: true

    Description: ID of user billing address to use for this credit card
    Example: "c6157dcf-c275-49a3-a96f-e81e8db2b0cb"

    Type: string
    Description: Card expiration month (2 digits).
    Example: "02"

  cc_year:
    Type: string
    Description: Card expiration year (4 digits).
    Example: "2025"

  alias:
    Type: string
    Description: Alias/nickname for this payment method.
    Example: "My Work Card"

  auto_generate_alias:
    Type: boolean
    Description: Auto-generate alias if not provided.
    Example: false

  cc_cvv:
    Type: string
    Description: Card Verification Value - the 3-digit security code on the back of most cards (4 digits on front for American Express).
    Example: "123"

  country_code:
    Type: string
    Description: Two-letter ISO country code where the card was issued or the billing address is located.
    Example: "US"

  billing_address:
    allOf:
      Reference to: `BillingAddressData`
    Description: Billing address information

  is_default:
    Type: boolean
    Default: false
    Description: Set this card as the default payment method.
    Example: true

  user_billing_address_id:
    Type: string
    Description: ID of user billing address to use for this credit card
    Example: "0e0d6bf1-8503-452f-86e0-3433517838b8"

### UserNotificationSettingsData

Type: object
Properties:
  new_translatable_items:
    Type: array
    Items: 
      Type: string
      Example: "broadcast"

    Description: List of channels for new translatable items notifications. Every time a batch of phrases is created in any of the projects where the user holds a translator role, the user will receive a notification through the selected channels. Leave empty to not receive any notifications.

  invitation:
    Type: array
    Items: 
      Type: string
      Example: "broadcast"

    Description: List of channels for invitation notifications. Every time a user is invited to a project or organization, the user will receive a notification through the selected channels. Leave empty to not receive any notifications.

  added_to_entity:
    Type: array
    Items: 
      Type: string
      Example: "broadcast"

    Description: List of channels for added to entity notifications. Every time a user is directly added to a project or organization (without going through the invitation flow), the user will receive a notification through the selected channels. Leave empty to not receive any notifications.



### OrganizationBillingSettingsData

Type: object
Properties:
  monthly_credit_usage_limit:
    Type: number
    Format: float
    Default: 0
    Description: Organization wide setting that determines the monthly usage limit for the organization.
    Example: 20

  auto_recharge_enabled:
    Type: boolean
    Default: false
    Description: Organization wide setting that determines whether the system should automatically recharge the organization when the usage limit is reached.
    Example: true

  auto_recharge_threshold:
    Type: number
    Format: float
    Default: 0
    Description: Organization wide setting that determines the threshold for automatic recharge.
    Example: 20

  auto_recharge_amount:
    Type: number
    Format: float
    Default: 0
    Description: Organization wide setting that determines the amount to recharge.
    Example: 20

  auto_recharge_source:
    Type: string
    Enum: ["account_balance", "credit_card", "account_balance_or_credit_card", "credit_card_or_account_balance"]
    Default: "account_balance_or_credit_card"
    Description: Organization wide setting that determines the source of the automatic recharge.
    Example: "credit_card"

  allow_draw_projects:
    Type: boolean
    Default: true
    Description: Organization wide setting that determines whether the system should allow projects to draw funds from the organization.
    Example: true

  draw_projects_limit_monthly:
    Type: number
    Format: float
    Description: Organization wide setting that determines the monthly limit for drawing funds from the projects.
    Example: 20



### AiTranslatorSettingsData

Type: object
Properties:
  machine_translate_new_phrases:
    Type: boolean
    Default: true
    Description: Project wide setting that determines whether the system should generate a machine translation for each new phrase created; this will only happen if the phrase doesnt have a translation/machine translation in the Organizations Translation Memory or if it has machine translations in the Organizations Translation Memory but the use_translation_memory setting is disabled.
    Example: true

  use_machine_translations:
    Type: boolean
    Default: true
    Description: Project wide setting that determines whether the system should return machine translations when searching for translations through the translations endpoint.
    Example: true

  translate_base_locale_only:
    Type: boolean
    Default: false
    Description: Project wide setting that when enabled will detect the language of your phrases before machine translating.  If it matches base_locale, it will be allowed to machine translate. If another locale is detected, the phrase will be marked to never translate automatically. Language detection may have an additional cost per phrase.  Use this option if you have mixed language content and want to be sure that other languages stay in their original form.
    Example: true

  tier:
    Type: string
    Enum: ["basic", "smart", "premium"]
    Default: "smart"
    Description: Translation tier — basic (Google, fastest/cheapest), smart (budget LLM, default), or premium (top-quality LLM). The underlying model is selected by langsys-ai based on the chosen tier.
    Example: "smart"



### LocaleSettingsData

Type: object
Properties:
  base_locale:
    Type: string
    Default: "en-us"
    Description: Project wide setting that determines the base locale for the project.
    Example: "en-us"

  target_locales:
    Type: array
    Items: 
      Type: string
      Example: "es-cr"

    Description: Project wide setting that determines the target locales for the project.

  default_locales:
    Type: object
    Description: Project wide setting that determines the default locales for each language in the project.
    Example: {"es":"es-cr"}

  use_translation_memory:
    Type: boolean
    Default: true
    Description: Project wide setting that determines whether the system should look in Translation Memory when using the translation search algorithm.
    Example: true

  locale_code_format:
    Type: string
    Enum: ["lowercase-hyphen", "bcp47", "posix"]
    Default: "lowercase-hyphen"
    Description: Organization wide setting that determines the format of locale codes in API responses.
    Example: "lowercase-hyphen"

### ProjectBillingSettingsData

Type: object
Properties:
  monthly_credit_usage_limit:
    Type: number
    Format: float
    Default: 0
    Description: Project wide setting that determines the monthly usage limit for the project. Setting to 0 is equivalent to unlimited usage.
    Example: 20

  auto_recharge_enabled:
    Type: boolean
    Default: false
    Description: Project wide setting that determines whether the system should automatically recharge the project when the usage limit is reached.
    Example: true

  auto_recharge_threshold:
    Type: number
    Format: float
    Default: 0
    Description: Project wide setting that determines the threshold for automatic recharge.
    Example: 20

  auto_recharge_amount:
    Type: number
    Format: float
    Default: 0
    Description: Project wide setting that determines the amount to recharge.
    Example: 20

  auto_recharge_source:
    Type: string
    Enum: ["organization_balance", "credit_card", "organization_balance_or_credit_card", "credit_card_or_organization_balance"]
    Default: "organization_balance_or_credit_card"
    Description: Project wide setting that determines the source of the automatic recharge.
    Example: "credit_card"



### UserBillingSettingsData

Type: object
Properties:
  monthly_credit_usage_limit:
    Type: number
    Format: float
    Default: 0
    Description: The maximum amount that can be drawn from the monthly balance of the user.
    Example: 100

  auto_recharge_enabled:
    Type: boolean
    Default: false
    Description: Whether auto recharge is enabled for the user
    Example: true

  auto_recharge_threshold:
    Type: number
    Format: float
    Default: 10
    Description: The amount that the balance of the user must drop below to trigger auto recharge.
    Example: 20

  auto_recharge_amount:
    Type: number
    Format: float
    Default: 50
    Description: The amount that will be added to the balance of the user when auto recharge is triggered.
    Example: 20

  allow_draw_organizations:
    Type: boolean
    Default: true
    Description: Whether the organizations can draw from the balance of the user
    Example: true

  draw_organizations_limit_monthly:
    Type: number
    Format: float
    Default: 20
    Description: The monthly limit that a single organization can draw from the balance of the user
    Example: 100

  locales:
    Type: object

### OrganizationData

Type: object
Properties:

    Type: string
    Example: "My Organization"

    Type: string

    Type: string

### ProjectContext

Type: object
Properties:

    Type: string

### NotificationData

Type: object
Properties:
  id:
    Type: string
    Example: "3d1f0c19-2e43-4916-a8e4-d498e09536a0"

  message:
    Type: string
    Example: "8 new phrase(s) have been created in Project ABC"

  type:
    Type: string
    Enum: ["invitation", "new_translatable_items", "added_to_entity"]
    Description: Type of notification. Should be used by client to decide how to display the notification.
    Example: "new_translatable_items"

  data:
    allOf:
      Reference to: `NotificationPayloadData`
    Description: Data of notification. Will be flexible based on the notification type, but will at least contain a list of entity IDs the notification is related to.

  created_at:
    Type: integer
    Example: 1781149482

  read_at:
    Type: integer
    Example: 1781149482



### SubscriptionSummary

Type: object
Properties:
  id:
    Type: string
    Description: Subscription ID
    Example: "337c91be-72e4-461d-8810-4934ea433a66"

  plan_type:
    Type: string
    Enum: ["free", "business", "enterprise"]
    Description: Type of the plan
    Example: "business"

  plan_cycle:
    Type: string
    Enum: ["monthly", "quarterly", "biannual", "yearly", "lifetime"]
    Description: Cycle of the plan
    Example: "monthly"

  status:
    Type: string
    Description: Status of the subscription
    Example: "active"

  next_billing_date:
    Type: integer
    Description: Next billing date (Unix timestamp)
    Example: 1767225600

  expiration_date:
    Type: integer
    Description: Expiration date (Unix timestamp) — set when a downgrade is scheduled
    Example: 1767225600



### NotificationPayloadData

Type: object
Properties:
  entity_ids:
    Type: array
    Items: 
      Type: string
      Example: "9f5ef8c1-edc7-4aab-8f69-2e0ac37f75b8"




### TranslationData

Type: object
Properties:
  phrase_id:
    Type: string
    Description: ID of the phrase to translate.
    Example: "123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000"

  translation:
    Type: string
    Description: Translation in queried locale.
    Example: "Inicio"

  translatable:
    Type: boolean
    Default: true
    Description: If this flag is false, the phrase will be marked as untranslatable for requested locale and all project target locales of the same language the user has access to. Default: true
    Example: true

    Description: List of items to permanently delete



### RestoreTrashData
